383.name: Wind Walker
description: Description : Increases Movement Speed and FLEE Rate of the caster and party members within a 13 x 13 cell area around self.
Movement Speed increase does not apply if Increase Agility or other Movement Speed–increasing effects are active.
The Movement Speed bonus is removed if affected by Quagmire or other Movement Speed–reducing effects.

24.name: Ruwach
description: Description : Reveals all hidden targets within a 5 x 5 cell area around the caster for 10 seconds.
If a revealed target is an enemy, deals Holy Magical Damage equal to MATK 145%.

384.name: Shattering Strike
description: Prerequisite : Skin Tempering Lv. 3, Hilt Binding Lv. 1, Weaponry Research Lv. 5, Power Thrust Lv. 3
Description : While Shattering Strike is active, attacking players has a chance to destroy their weapon or armor, while attacking monsters reduces their ATK or DEF.
The destruction chance increases with skill level.
Additionally, increases the caster’s damage for the duration, with further damage increased based on the caster’s LUK.

8222.name: Magnificat
description: Description : Doubles SP recovery speed of the mercenary, summoner, and party members.

387.name: Cart Boost
description: Prerequisite : Pushcart Lv. 5, Cart Revolution Lv. 1, Change Cart Lv. 1
Description : While Cart Boost is active, increases Movement Speed when a cart is equipped.
Allows the caster to ignore Decrease Agility and other Movement Speed–reducing effects.

389.name: Stealth

1.text: Movement Speed 70%, SP Consumption 12 per 10 sec, after 10 sec STR +1

2.text: Movement Speed 75%, SP Consumption 14 per 10 sec, after 10 sec STR +2

3.text: Movement Speed 80%, SP Consumption 16 per 10 sec, after 10 sec STR +4

4.text: Movement Speed 85%, SP Consumption 18 per 10 sec, after 10 sec STR +8

5.text: Movement Speed 90%, SP Consumption 20 per 10 sec, after 10 sec STR +16

description: Description : Move while concealed under Hiding.
Cannot be detected by Sight, Ruwach, or Improve Concentration.
Unlike Hiding, takes damage from area-of-effect attacks and leaves footprints while moving.
Ineffective against Insect, Demon, and Boss monsters.
Attacking and using skills is disabled while active.
Usable in Siege Mode, but SP consumption is increased by 5 times.
Natural SP recovery is disabled while active.
[Lv 1] Movement Speed 70%, SP Consumption 12 per 10 sec, after 10 sec STR +1
[Lv 2] Movement Speed 75%, SP Consumption 14 per 10 sec, after 10 sec STR +2
[Lv 3] Movement Speed 80%, SP Consumption 16 per 10 sec, after 10 sec STR +4
[Lv 4] Movement Speed 85%, SP Consumption 18 per 10 sec, after 10 sec STR +8
[Lv 5] Movement Speed 90%, SP Consumption 20 per 10 sec, after 10 sec STR +16

390.name: Counter Instinct
description: Description : If the enemy is using a sword-type weapon, has a chance to deflect the attack, reducing damage taken by 50%.
The deflection chance increases with skill level.
Up to 3 attacks can be deflected after using the skill.
Applies to attacks from all monsters.
Deflected damage is reflected back to the attacker.

394.name: Arrow Vulcan
description: Prerequisite : Double Strafe Lv. 5, Arrow Shower Lv. 5, Melody Strike Lv. 1 (Slinging Arrow Lv. 1)
Description : Rapidly fires a large number of Arrows at a single target.
Bard requires an instrument equipped, and Dancer requires a whip equipped.

395.name: Sheltering Bliss
description: Prerequisite : Improve Concentration Lv. 5, Music Lessons Lv. 7
Prerequisite : Improve Concentration Lv. 5, Dance Lessons Lv. 7
Description : An ensemble skill performed by Bard and Dancer.
Creates a barrier in a 5 x 5 cells area around the performer that prevents entry.
The barrier does not block magic or ranged attacks.
Cannot be activated if there are obstacles nearby.

396.name: Marionette Control
description: Prerequisite : Improve Concentration Lv. 10, Music Lessons Lv. 5
Prerequisite : Improve Concentration Lv. 10, Dance Lessons Lv. 5
Description : Transfers all of the caster’s base stats to the target.
The target receives half of each stat transferred, up to a maximum of 99 per stat.
The effect is canceled if the distance between the caster and the target exceeds 7 cells.

397.name: Clashing Spiral
description: Prerequisite : Spear Mastery Lv. 5, Pierce Lv. 5, Peco Peco Ride Lv. 1, Spear Stab Lv. 5
Description : Unleashes a spiraling thrust that strikes the target multiple times.
Damage increases based on weapon weight and immobilizes the target for 1 sec.
Damage increases with skill level, but casting time and after-cast delay also increase.
Usable only when a spear, one-handed sword, or two-handed sword is equipped.

398.name: Traumatic Blow
description: Prerequisite : Spear Mastery Lv. 9, Peco Peco Ride Lv. 1
Description : Strikes the target with a powerful blow, with a chance to inflict Bleeding.
Bleeding targets take additional damage over time.

399.name: Vital Strike
description: Prerequisite : Spear Mastery Lv. 9, Peco Peco Ride Lv. 1, Cavalier Mastery Lv. 3, Traumatic Blow Lv. 3
Description : Usable only while wielding a spear.
Attacks the target’s joints to inflict various effects.
As skill level increases, both damage and the chance to inflict Status Ailment increase.

25.name: Pneuma
description: Description : Creates a protective area at the designated location and within a 3 x 3 cell radius for 10 seconds, blocking ranged physical damage.

400.name: Napalm Vulcan
description: Description : Uses psychokinesis to deal Ghost Magical Damage to a distant target and all enemies in a 3 x 3 area around it, with a low chance to inflict Curse.
As skill level increases, the number of hits increases, and damage scales with the caster’s Base Level.

401.name: Zen
description: Description : A technique that gathers inner energy at great risk, instantly summoning up to 5 Spirit Spheres required for Summon Spirit Sphere.

402.name: Mind Breaker
description: Prerequisite : Increase SP Recovery Lv. 3, Soul Siphon Lv. 2
Description : Attacks the target’s mind, causing mental collapse.
Decreases the target’s magic defense while increasing magic attack power.
Success rate increases with skill level.

403.name: Foresight
description: Prerequisite : Study Lv. 5, Free Cast Lv. 5, Hindsight Lv. 1
Description : After using Foresight, the next 5 skill casts have their Variable Casting Time reduced by half.
The effect remains until all uses are consumed, and is removed upon death.
The casting time of Foresight itself is fixed at 5 sec and is not affected by DEX.

404.name: Blinding Mist
description: Description : Creates a wall of fog in a 5 x 3 area, inflicting Blind on players or monsters and making attacks more difficult.
Ranged attacks and magic cast on targets within the area have reduced damage and an increased chance to miss.
In normal fields, the effect applies only to monsters, while in PvP zones it also applies to players.

405.name: Fiber Lock
description: Fires a Cobweb to bind the target. Up to 2 webs can be active at the same time.
Lasts for 8 sec. Monsters bound by Cobweb have their FLEE Rate reduced by half.
If a bound target is hit by a Fire-Property attack, it takes double damage and is released from the Cobweb.
Has no effect on Boss monsters.

406.name: Meteor Assault
description: Prerequisite : Katar Mastery Lv. 5, Righthand Mastery Lv. 3, Sonic Blow Lv. 5, Soul Destroyer Lv. 1
Description : Strikes all targets in a 5 x 5 area around the caster with a powerful blow.
Enemies hit have a chance to be inflicted with Stun, Blind, or Bleeding.
Damage increases based on the caster’s AGI and Base Level.

407.name: Create Deadly Poison
description: Prerequisite : Envenom Lv. 10, Detoxify Lv. 1, Enchant Poison Lv. 5
Description : Creates a deadly poison using various materials and obtains 1 Poison Bottle.
Required materials: Poison Fang, Cactus Needle, Bee Sting, Poison Mushroom Spore, Karvodailnirol, Frenzy Potion, and Empty Bottle (1 each).
Success rate increases based on DEX and LUK. On failure, 25% of Max HP is lost.
When consumed by an Assassin Cross, it inflicts poison but increases attack speed. If consumed by other players, it causes immediate Suicide.

408.name: Mom, Dad, I love you!
description: Description : Consumes 10% of Max SP to grant your parents the effect of not losing EXP upon death for 2 min.

409.name: Mom, Dad, I miss you!
description: Description : Summons your parents to your current location.
Cannot be used in areas where Warp Portal is unavailable or on Siege maps.

410.name: Come to me, honey~
description: Description : Summons your Baby to your current location.
Cannot be used in areas where Warp Portal is unavailable or on Siege maps.

26.name: Teleport

1.text: Teleports to a random location on the current map

description: Description : Instantly moves the caster to another location.
Cannot be used while under the effect of Land Protector.
[Lv 1] Teleports to a random location on the current map

27.name: Warp Portal
description: Description : Creates a dimensional portal at the designated location that transports players to another area. Up to 8 players can be transported regardless of skill level, and 1 Blue Gemstone is consumed.
Cannot be used while under the effect of Land Protector.
[Custom Location] Refers to a memorized location. Use the [/memo] command on the desired map to register it.

10014.name: Permanent Development
description: Description : When Development increases, there is a 50% chance to gain an additional +1 Development, allowing an increase of 1 or 2 at once.

5065.name: Go! Parents Go!
description: Description : Grants parents within a 7 x 7 area around self +3 to all stats for 60 sec.

28.name: Heal
description: Description : Recovers the target player’s HP. In addition to the base Heal effect determined by skill level, the recovery amount is further increased based on the caster’s level, total INT, and the base and refined magic attack power of the equipped weapon.
When used on Undead-Property monsters, deals special Holy Magical Damage equal to 50% of the Heal effect.

8207.name: Double Strafe
description: Description : Fires two Arrow at a target, dealing double hits.

8223.name: Weapon Quicken
description: Description : Temporarily increases the mercenary’s ASPD.

29.name: Increase Agility
description: Description : Increases the target’s movement speed for a certain duration and additionally increases ASPD (reduces After Attack Delay). Consumes an additional 15 HP upon use.
When used on a target afflicted with [Status Ailment : Decrease Agility], the status is removed and the Increase Agility effect is applied.

475.name: Preserve
description: Description : Prevents skills copied via Plagiarism from being overwritten when hit by another skill.

476.name: Full Divestment
description: Description : Applies the effects of all four Divest skills simultaneously.
Success chance increases if your DEX is higher than the target’s DEX.

478.name: Aid Condensed Potion
description: Description : Consumes 1 Slim Potion and throws it to recover HP of party members within a 7 x 7 area around the target location.
Only standard Slim Potions can be used. Ranking bonuses do not apply when using Aid Condensed Potion.

479.name: Full Chemical Protection
description: Prerequisite : Chemical Protection (Helm, Shield, Armor, Weapon) Lv. 5
Description : Applies the effects of all four Chemical Protection skills simultaneously.

30.name: Decrease Agility
description: Description : Attempts to inflict [Status Ailment : Decrease Agility] on the target for a certain duration.
While active, the target’s AGI is reduced and movement speed is decreased.

480.name: Rapid Smiting
description: Description : Shield-exclusive skill. Attacks the enemy with a shield.
Affected by the user’s HIT. Additional damage is added based on the user’s Base Level, shield refinement, and shield weight.

481.name: Spiritual Thrift
description: Prerequisite : Mace Mastery Lv. 10, Demon Bane Lv. 10
Description : Reduces SP consumption of skills.

482.name: Double Bolt
description: Description : While active, casting Bolt-type skills has a chance to trigger an additional cast.
Does not reduce Variable Casting Time.

483.name: Ganbantein
description: Prerequisite : Sense Lv. 1, Ice Wall Lv. 1
Description : Has a chance to cancel all ground-targeted spells within a 3 x 3 area centered on the target cell.
Consumes 1 Blue Gemstone and 1 Yellow Gemstone.
When used on Land Protector, removes Land Protector within a 3 x 3 area.
Gemstone consumption cannot be reduced by items or skills.

484.name: Gravitational Field
description: Prerequisite : Quagmire Lv. 1, Stave Crasher Lv. 1, Mystical Amplification Lv. 10
Description : Creates a surge of gravity within a 5 x 5 area centered on the target cell, dealing Neutral Magical Damage.
The number of hits increases with skill level, and damage increases based on the caster’s Base Level.

485.name: High Speed Cart Ram
description: Prerequisite : Mammonite Lv. 10, Geneticist Cart Boost Lv. 1
Description : Can only be used while Geneticist Cart Boost is active.
Strikes a single enemy with a cart, consuming Zeny and having a chance to inflict Stun.
Damage increases with skill level and is affected by cart weight.

486.name: Maximum Power-Thrust
description: Description : Consumes Zeny to greatly increase weapon attack power.
Unlike Power Thrust, this effect applies only to the caster.
The effect is removed when changing equipment.

488.name: Hermode's Rod
description: Prerequisite : Improve Concentration Lv. 10, Music Lessons Lv. 10
Prerequisite : Improve Concentration Lv. 10, Dance Lessons Lv. 10
Description : Can only be used in Siege Mode when a Warp Zone is present nearby.
Removes all buff magic except Frenzy from all allied characters within range (excluding the caster) and renders them immune to magic.
The effect ends immediately when leaving the area. While within the area, allied players including the caster cannot use skills.

489.name: Tarot Card of Fate
description: Prerequisite : Improve Concentration Lv. 10, Unchained Serenade Lv. 3
Prerequisite : Improve Concentration Lv. 10, Hip Shaker Lv. 3
Description : Attempts to affect a single enemy. On success, applies one of 14 random card effects.
Success chance increases with skill level.

490.name: Acid Bomb
description: Prerequisite : Bomb Lv. 5, Acid Terror Lv. 5
Description : Consumes 1 Molotov Cocktail and 1 Acid Bottle to deal Ranged Physical Damage to a target.
Damage increases based on the caster’s INT, the target’s VIT, and the caster’s Base Level.
Deals only 50% damage to non-monster characters and may damage the target’s weapon and armor based on skill level.

31.name: Aqua Benedicta
description: Description : Fills an Empty Bottle with holy water, creating 1 Holy Water. Must be used while standing in shallow water.

8008.name: Blood Lust

1.text: Duration 1 min / Damage 130% / Chance 3% / Cooldown 5 min

2.text: Duration 3 min / Damage 140% / Chance 6% / Cooldown 10 min

3.text: Duration 5 min / Damage 150% / Chance 9% / Cooldown 15 min

description: Description : Increases the homunculus’s attack power for up to 5 min.
Has a chance to recover HP equal to 20% of damage dealt.
[Lv 1] Duration 1 min / Damage 130% / Chance 3% / Cooldown 5 min
[Lv 2] Duration 3 min / Damage 140% / Chance 6% / Cooldown 10 min
[Lv 3] Duration 5 min / Damage 150% / Chance 9% / Cooldown 15 min

2041.name: Clementia

1.text: Effect Range: 3 cells around the caster / Duration 120 sec

2.text: Effect Range: 7 cells around the caster / Duration 180 sec

3.text: Effect Range: 15 cells around the caster / Duration 240 sec

description: Description : Grants all nearby party members the Acolyte skill [Blessing] effect centered on the caster. The higher the caster’s Job Lv, the stronger the Blessing effect.
[Lv 1] Effect Range: 3 cells around the caster / Duration 120 sec
[Lv 2] Effect Range: 7 cells around the caster / Duration 180 sec
[Lv 3] Effect Range: 15 cells around the caster / Duration 240 sec

2.name: Sword Mastery
description: Description : Increases physical damage when attacking enemies with a one-handed sword or dagger by an additional amount per skill level.

32.name: Signum Crucis
description: Description : Etches the sign of the cross to reduce the physical defense of Demon-type and Undead Monsters on the screen.

8208.name: Arrow Shower
description: Description : Fires multiple Arrow at once, damaging the target and nearby enemies.

33.name: Angelus
description: Description : Recites a sacred prayer to increase physical defense based on VIT and Max HP for the caster and all party members on screen for a certain duration.

34.name: Blessing

1.text: STR, INT, DEX +1, HIT +2, Duration: 60 sec

2.text: STR, INT, DEX +2, HIT +4, Duration: 80 sec

3.text: STR, INT, DEX +3, HIT +6, Duration: 100 sec

4.text: STR, INT, DEX +4, HIT +8, Duration: 120 sec

5.text: STR, INT, DEX +5, HIT +10, Duration: 140 sec

6.text: STR, INT, DEX +6, HIT +12, Duration: 160 sec

7.text: STR, INT, DEX +7, HIT +14, Duration: 180 sec

8.text: STR, INT, DEX +8, HIT +16, Duration: 200 sec

9.text: STR, INT, DEX +9, HIT +18, Duration: 220 sec

10.text: STR, INT, DEX +10, HIT +20, Duration: 240 sec

description: Description : Temporarily increases the target’s STR, INT, DEX, and HIT.
When used on a player afflicted with Curse or Petrification, cures the Status Ailment.
When used on Undead or Demon Monsters, reduces STR, INT, and DEX by 50%.
[Lv 1] STR, INT, DEX +1, HIT +2, Duration: 60 sec
[Lv 2] STR, INT, DEX +2, HIT +4, Duration: 80 sec
[Lv 3] STR, INT, DEX +3, HIT +6, Duration: 100 sec
[Lv 4] STR, INT, DEX +4, HIT +8, Duration: 120 sec
[Lv 5] STR, INT, DEX +5, HIT +10, Duration: 140 sec
[Lv 6] STR, INT, DEX +6, HIT +12, Duration: 160 sec
[Lv 7] STR, INT, DEX +7, HIT +14, Duration: 180 sec
[Lv 8] STR, INT, DEX +8, HIT +16, Duration: 200 sec
[Lv 9] STR, INT, DEX +9, HIT +18, Duration: 220 sec
[Lv 10] STR, INT, DEX +10, HIT +20, Duration: 240 sec

35.name: Cure
description: Description : Cures the Status Ailment when used on a player afflicted with Silence, Confusion, or Blind.

2278.name: Axe Boomerang
description: Description : Throws an axe at a distant enemy, dealing damage and knocking the target back. Damage increases based on the axe’s weight.

2286.name: Shadow Spell
description: Description : Allows magic skills learned through Intimidate to be used via Shadow Spell.
Increases magic attack for the duration, and basic physical attacks have a chance to trigger the learned magic skill.

36.name: Enlarge Weight Limit
description: Description : Increases the maximum weight capacity for carrying items.

2338.name: Rising Dragon
description: Description : Temporarily unleashes the caster’s inner energy, increasing the maximum number of Spirit Sphere.
Increases MHP and MSP by (Skill Lv)% and maintains Fury status for the duration.

37.name: Discount
description: Description : Allows items to be purchased from standard NPC shops at a reduced price compared to the base cost.

38.name: Overcharge
description: Description : Allows items to be sold to NPC shops at a higher price than the standard offer.

39.name: Pushcart
description: Description : Allows use of a cart capable of carrying large quantities of items.
The cart can be rented from a Kafra Employee and accessed with the [Alt+W] key.
At Lv. 1, movement speed is reduced while using a cart, but the penalty is gradually reduced as skill level increases, fully removed at Lv. 10.
Items stored in the cart cannot be used directly.

10000.name: Official Guild Approval
description: Description : Grants official guild recognition from the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom. Members of an approved guild can attack the Emperium required to occupy a guild stronghold.

2534.name: To El Dicastes
description: Description : Returns to El Dicastes, the capital of Sapha.
Cannot be reused for 5 minutes after use.

2546.name: Minimize Physical item attack rate
description: Description : Minimizes the physical item attack rate.

8209.name: Skid Trap
description: Description : Sets a trap that causes enemies who step on it to slide in a designated direction.

8225.name: Crash
description: Description : Attacks a target with a chance to inflict Stun.

8241.name: Mind Blaster
description: Description : Severs the link between a follower and the Demon King, nullifying demonic blessings. Range: 2 cells.

41.name: Vending
description: Description : Can only be used while a cart is equipped. Opens a temporary shop at the current location to sell various items.
Only items stored in the cart can be sold, and the number of different items that can be listed increases with skill level.

42.name: Mammonite
description: Description : Strikes a designated enemy with a powerful blow fueled by wealth.

688.name: Goodnight, Sweety
description: Description : Sings an irresistible Lullaby, putting the target into Sleep for a certain duration.

692.name: Monster's Cry
description: Description : A cat’s cry echoes to scare away rats.

695.name: Summer Dream
description: Description : Using this skill feels like drifting into a Summer Dream.

698.name: Christmas Carol
description: Description : A blessing song for the long-awaited holy night. Beware—singing it to singles may cause unexpected side effects.

45.name: Improve Concentration
description: Description : Temporarily increases DEX and AGI.
Additionally, when Improve Concentration is cast, hidden targets within a 3×3 cell area around the caster are revealed.

8009.name: Moonlight
description: Description : Performs consecutive pecking attacks on a nearby target.

10017.name: Thrust Flag
description: Description : Usable only in Siege Mode. Can only be used by the guild Pub Playmate. Deploys a flag to allow Guildsman to gather immediately.

3.name: Two Handed Sword Mastery
description: Description : Increases physical damage when attacking enemies with a two-handed sword by an additional amount per skill level.

8226.name: Regain
description: Description : Cures Stun and Sleep Status Ailment.

49.name: Improve Dodge
description: Description : Increases the chance to evade enemy attacks. After second job advancement, the amount of FLEE Rate gained is increased.
For Assassin Class, an additional movement speed increase effect is also applied.

50.name: Steal
description: Description : Attempts to steal an item carried by the target. The success rate decreases as the target’s DEX becomes higher than the caster’s.
This skill does not work on Boss monsters or players, and an item cannot be stolen more than once from the same target.

51.name: Hiding

1.text: Duration: 30 seconds, additional SP consumption: 1 every 5 sec

2.text: Duration: 60 seconds, additional SP consumption: 1 every 6 sec

3.text: Duration: 90 seconds, additional SP consumption: 1 every 7 sec

4.text: Duration: 120 seconds, additional SP consumption: 1 every 8 sec

5.text: Duration: 150 seconds, additional SP consumption: 1 every 9 sec

6.text: Duration: 180 seconds, additional SP consumption: 1 every 10 sec

7.text: Duration: 210 seconds, additional SP consumption: 1 every 11 sec

8.text: Duration: 240 seconds, additional SP consumption: 1 every 12 sec

9.text: Duration: 270 seconds, additional SP consumption: 1 every 13 sec

10.text: Duration: 300 seconds, additional SP consumption: 1 every 14 sec

description: Description : Hides underground. Can be detected by enemy detection skills.
Can be detected by Demon-type enemies, Insect Monsters, and Boss monsters. Using Hiding again while hidden will cancel the Hiding state.
Natural SP recovery is disabled while hidden.
[Lv 1] Duration: 30 seconds, additional SP consumption: 1 every 5 sec
[Lv 2] Duration: 60 seconds, additional SP consumption: 1 every 6 sec
[Lv 3] Duration: 90 seconds, additional SP consumption: 1 every 7 sec
[Lv 4] Duration: 120 seconds, additional SP consumption: 1 every 8 sec
[Lv 5] Duration: 150 seconds, additional SP consumption: 1 every 9 sec
[Lv 6] Duration: 180 seconds, additional SP consumption: 1 every 10 sec
[Lv 7] Duration: 210 seconds, additional SP consumption: 1 every 11 sec
[Lv 8] Duration: 240 seconds, additional SP consumption: 1 every 12 sec
[Lv 9] Duration: 270 seconds, additional SP consumption: 1 every 13 sec
[Lv 10] Duration: 300 seconds, additional SP consumption: 1 every 14 sec

52.name: Envenom
description: Description : Deals Poison-Property physical damage to a target. Has a chance to inflict [Status Ailment : Poison].
Poisoned targets take damage proportional to MHP every second, and their physical defense is reduced by 25%.
The damage bonus from Envenom is added to normal physical attack damage.

53.name: Detoxify
description: Description : Cures the Poison Status Ailment when used on a poisoned player.

54.name: Resurrection
description: Prerequisite : Increase SP Recovery Lv. 4, Status Recovery Lv. 1
Description : Consumes 1 Blue Gemstone to revive an incapacitated player.

55.name: Spear Mastery
description: Description : Increases physical damage when attacking with a spear.
Damage is further increased while mounted.

10002.name: Guardian Research
description: Description : Conducts technical research on Guardians, enabling installation of Guardians to protect the stronghold.

10018.name: Ringing Thrust
description: Description : Usable only in Siege Mode. Can be used by any Guildsman to instantly move to the location where Thrust Flag is deployed.

56.name: Pierce
description: Deals melee physical damage with multiple hits based on target size.
Damage increases with STR, and HIT is increased when used.

8211.name: Sandman
description: Description : Sets a trap that inflicts Sleep on enemies who step on it and nearby enemies.

8227.name: Tender
description: Description : Cures Frozen and Petrification Status Ailment.

57.name: Brandish Spear
description: Prerequisite : Peco Peco Ride Lv. 1, Spear Stab Lv. 3
Can only be used while mounted.
Swings the spear in a wide arc, dealing Ranged Physical Damage in a forward area from the caster toward the target.
Damage is further increased based on the caster’s STR.
Has a short preparation time, during which weapon switching is not possible.

58.name: Spear Stab
description: Thrusts the spear deeply, dealing Ranged Physical Damage to the target and all enemies between the caster and the target.

59.name: Spear Boomerang
description: Throws a spear at the target, dealing Ranged Physical Damage.
At Lv. 1, deals Melee Physical Damage instead.

60.name: Two Hand Quicken
description: Prerequisite : Two Handed Sword Mastery Lv. 1
Increases CRIT, HIT, and ASPD for a duration.
The effect is canceled if a weapon other than a two-handed sword is equipped or unequipped.
Also removed by Quagmire and Decrease Agility.

61.name: Counter Attack
description: Prerequisite : Two Handed Sword Mastery Lv. 1
Description : During the counter window, blocks a frontal melee physical attack and automatically counterattacks.
The counterattack is a normal physical attack, not a skill attack, and can critically hit.

62.name: Bowling Bash
description: Prerequisite : Bash Lv. 10, Magnum Break Lv. 3, Two Handed Sword Mastery Lv. 5, Two Hand Quicken Lv. 10, Counter Attack Lv. 5
Description : Deals Melee Physical Damage to the target 3 times and knocks it back.
When using a two-handed sword, the number of hits increases based on nearby enemies, up to a maximum of 5 hits.
Damage is further increased based on the caster’s STR, and weapon switching is disabled briefly after use.

1001.name: Charge Attack
description: Prerequisite : Available after completing the quest.

Description : Rushes toward a distant enemy and strikes instantly, dealing ATK 700% damage and knocking the target back by 2 cells. Knockback increases to 4 cells in PvP areas, and is removed entirely in siege areas.

1002.name: Shrink
description: Prerequisite : Available after completing the quest.
Description : For 15 min, successfully auto-guarding with Guard has a high chance to inflict Status Ailment Stun on the attacker. Using Shrink again during its duration cancels the effect.

1003.name: Sonic Acceleration
description: Prerequisite : Available after completing the quest.
Description : When using Sonic Blow, increases HIT by 90% and boosts Sonic Blow damage by 90%.

1004.name: Venom Knife
description: Prerequisite : Available after completing the quest.
Description : Throws 1 equipped Venom Knife at the target, dealing ATK 500% Ranged Physical Damage. The target has a high chance to be inflicted with Status Ailment Poison.

1005.name: Close Confine
description: Prerequisite : Available after completing the quest.

Description : Restrains the target for 10 sec, preventing movement. The caster is also immobilized. While restraining, increases FLEE by 50. The effect is canceled if either character uses Fly Wing, Butterfly Wing, or Teleport, becomes incapacitated, is affected by knockback, the distance between them increases, or the caster enters Hiding. Does not apply to boss monsters.

1006.name: Sight Blaster
description: Prerequisite : Available after completing the quest.

Description : For 15 min, flames of Sight orbit around the caster for protection. When an enemy approaches within 3 x 3 cells around the caster, the flame deals MATK 600% Fire Magical Damage and knocks the target back by 3 cells. The flame dissipates after dealing damage.

63.name: Peco Peco Ride
description: Description : Allows the character to ride a trained Peco Peco.
You can obtain directions to the ‘Pecopeco Trainer’ from the Guide in each city.

1008.name: Elemental Change - Water
description: Prerequisite : Available after completing the quest.
Description : Consumes 1 Water-Property Elemental Converter to change the target monster’s property to Water-Property with a certain chance.

1009.name: Phantasmic Arrow
description: Prerequisite : Available after completing the quest.

Description : Creates a phantom Arrow even without arrows equipped and fires it at the target, dealing ATK 500% Ranged Physical Damage as Wind-Property damage. Knocks the target back by 3 cells on hit.

1010.name: Pang Voice
description: Prerequisite : Available after completing the quest.
Description : Emits a terrifying scream with a high chance to inflict Status Ailment Confusion and Bleeding on the target. Has no effect on boss monsters.

10019.name: Emergency Move
description: Description : Usable only in Siege Mode. Can only be used by the guild Pub Playmate. Greatly increases the movement speed of nearby Guildsman.

1012.name: Dubious Salesmanship
description: Prerequisite : Available after completing the quest.
Description : Reduces the Zeny cost of Mammonite and High Speed Cart Ram by 20%.

1014.name: Redemptio
description: Prerequisite : Available after completing the quest.
Description : Leaves the caster with 1 HP and resurrects all party members on the screen. Revived players recover 50% HP.

1015.name: Spiritual Bestowment
description: Prerequisite : Available after completing the quest.
Description : Allows the caster to transfer collected Spirit Sphere to party members. Each cast transfers 1 Spirit Sphere.

1016.name: Excruciating Palm
description: Prerequisite : Available after completing the quest.
Description : Consumes 200 HP to focus energy into the palm, dealing ATK 800% Melee Physical Damage to the target, with a chance to inflict Status Ailment Stun on nearby enemies and knock them back.

1017.name: Elemental Change - Ground
description: Prerequisite : Available after completing the quest.
Description : Consumes 1 Earth-Property Elemental Converter to change the target monster’s property to Earth-Property with a certain chance.

1018.name: Elemental Change - Fire
description: Prerequisite : Available after completing the quest.
Description : Consumes 1 Fire-Property Elemental Converter to change the target monster’s property to Fire-Property with a certain chance.

1019.name: Elemental Change - Wind
description: Prerequisite : Available after completing the quest.
Description : Consumes 1 Wind-Property Elemental Converter to change the target monster’s property to Wind-Property with a certain chance.

4.name: Increase HP Recovery
description: Description : Recovers additional HP every 10 seconds while standing still. The recovery amount increases based on a fixed value plus a percentage of MHP.
HP will not be recovered while moving or when penalties that prevent HP/SP recovery due to weight are applied.

64.name: Cavalier Mastery
description: Description : Increases movement speed while riding a Peco Peco and allows attacking while mounted.
However, ASPD is reduced; when using Pub Playmate, ASPD is restored to normal.

8228.name: Benediction
description: Description : Cures Curse and Blind Status Ailment.

65.name: Mace Mastery
description: Description : Increases CRIT when attacking with a mace-type weapon, and adds bonus physical damage based on skill level.

66.name: Impositio Manus
description: Description : Bestows a blessing that increases ATK and MATK for yourself and nearby party members for 120 seconds.

67.name: Suffragium
description: Description : Offers a prayer on behalf of others, reducing Variable Casting Time for yourself and nearby party members for 60 seconds.

68.name: Aspersio
description: 8Prerequisite : Aqua Benedicta Lv. 1, Impositio Manus Lv. 3
23Prerequisite : Aqua Benedicta Lv. 1, Impositio Manus Lv. 1
Description : Consumes 1 Holy Water to temporarily grant Holy-Property to the target’s weapon.

69.name: B.S Sacramenti
description: Description : Performs a sacred rite of Eucharistic adoration.
Grants Holy-Property to the armor of players within a 3 x 3 cells area around the blessed ground.
Requires two additional Acolyte Class characters, one standing on each adjacent side of the caster.
When used on Undead-Property or Demon Monsters, deals a fixed amount of Holy-Property damage.

70.name: Sanctuary
description: Description : Consumes 1 Blue Gemstone to create a consecrated sanctuary in a 5 x 5 cells area.
Recovers HP of targets within the area once every second. Skill level increases Duration, Heal effect, and the maximum number of targets.
If Undead-Property or Demon Monsters enter the area, deals Holy Magical Damage equal to half of the Heal effect and knocks them back by 2 cells.

71.name: Slow Poison
description: Description : Temporarily halts the progression of poison.

2279.name: Power Swing
description: Description : Swings the weapon with great force at a single target, dealing Melee Physical Damage and inflicting [Status Ailment : Stun]. Damage increases based on the caster’s Base Level, STR, and DEX.

72.name: Status Recovery
description: Description : Cures severe Status Ailment effects such as Frozen, Stone Curse, and certain special skill effects.
When used on Undead Monsters, inflicts [Status Ailment: Blind].

2307.name: Cannon Spear
description: Description : Spear-exclusive skill. Deals Ranged Physical Damage to a target enemy and all enemies within range.
Damage increases based on the caster’s Base Lv and STR.
Applies Critical Damage based on the caster’s CRIT, with only half of the total Critical Damage bonus applied.

73.name: Kyrie Eleison
description: Description : Grants a protective barrier to a single player for 120 seconds.
The barrier’s durability is based on the target’s Max HP. Skill level increases durability and the maximum number of blocked attacks.
The barrier is removed if hit by Holy Light.

74.name: Magnificat
description: Description : Doubles the natural SP recovery rate of the caster and party members on screen for a set duration.

75.name: Gloria
description: Description : Increases LUK by 30 for the caster and party members on screen for a set duration.

76.name: Lex Divina
description: Description : Has a chance to inflict [Status Ailment: Silence] on the target.
The base Silence Duration is determined by skill level but may be reduced depending on the target’s status.
When used on a target already affected by [Status Ailment: Silence], removes that status.

77.name: Turn Undead
description: Prerequisite : Resurrection Lv. 1, Lex Divina Lv. 3
Description : Has a chance to instantly destroy an Undead-Property monster.
If the attempt fails, deals Holy Magical Damage equal to 30% of MATK.

78.name: Lex Aeterna
description: Description : Applies a state to the target that causes the next attack to deal double damage.
Cannot be used on targets affected by Frozen or petrification.

10004.name: Guild Extension
description: Description : Expands the guild structure, increasing the maximum number of guild members.

79.name: Magnus Exorcismus
description: Prerequisite : Turn Undead Lv. 3, Lex Aeterna Lv. 1, Safety Wall Lv. 1
Description : Consumes 1 Blue Gemstone to create a giant holy cross on the ground.
Enemies within the area take Holy Magical Damage equal to 100% of MATK once every 3 seconds.
Demon Monsters, Undead-Property, and Shadow-Property enemies take 130% of MATK as Holy Magical Damage per hit.

5068.name: Skilled Special Singer
description: 19Prerequisite : Marionette Control Lv. 1, Unchained Serenade Lv. 3, Music Lessons Lv. 10
20Prerequisite : Marionette Control Lv. 1, Hip Shaker Lv. 3, Dance Lessons Lv. 10
Description : Immediately removes ensemble aftereffects after a Gypsy and Clown ensemble skill.

2547.name: Max Magic item attack rate
description: Description : Maximizes the magical item attack rate.

5.name: Bash
description: Description : Strikes a target with great force to deal heavy damage.
If Fatal Blow has been learned, has a chance to inflict [Status Ailment : Stun] on the target starting from [Lv 6].

80.name: Fire Pillar
description: Description : Summons a pillar of fire at the targeted location, dealing Fire Magical Damage to enemies that step on it.
If no one triggers it within 30 seconds of Duration, the pillar disappears naturally.
Up to 5 pillars can be placed at once.
Cannot be placed if any ally or enemy, including the caster, is within 3 x 3 cells around the target cell.

8229.name: Recuperate
description: Description : Cures Silence and Poison Status Ailment.

81.name: Sightrasher
description: Prerequisite : Sight Lv. 1, Lightning Bolt Lv. 1
Description : Scatters the fire orbs summoned by Sight in eight directions, dealing Fire Magical Damage to nearby enemies and knocking them back by 2 cells.
After use, the fire orbs summoned by Sight disappear.

82.name: Fire Ivy
description: Description : Summons a vine of flames that crawls along erected walls.

83.name: Meteor Storm
description: Prerequisite : Thunder Storm Lv. 1, Sightrasher Lv. 1
Description : Calls down meteors over a 13 x 13 area around the targeted cell, dealing Fire Magical Damage equal to 125% of MATK and inflicting [Status Ailment : Stun] with a certain chance.
Each meteor affects a 7 x 7 area. Damage is further increased based on the caster’s INT, and the number of meteors and hits per meteor increase with skill level.

84.name: Jupitel Thunder
description: Prerequisite : Napalm Beat Lv. 1, Lightning Bolt Lv. 1
Description : Launches a lightning orb at the target, dealing Wind Magical Damage equal to 100% of MATK and knocking the target back once per hit.
The number of hits increases with skill level.

85.name: Lord of Vermilion
description: Prerequisite : Thunder Storm Lv. 1, Jupitel Thunder Lv. 3
Description : Summons concentrated lightning strikes over a 13 x 13 area around the targeted cell, dealing Wind Magical Damage and inflicting [Status Ailment : Blind] with a certain chance.
The chance to inflict Blind is reduced by the target’s Status Ailment resistance, and damage is further increased based on the caster’s INT.

86.name: Waterball

1.text: Damage per hit: MATK 130%, Detection Range: 1 x 1

2.text: Damage per hit: MATK 160%, Detection Range: 3 x 3

3.text: Damage per hit: MATK 190%, Detection Range: 3 x 3

4.text: Damage per hit: MATK 220%, Detection Range: 5 x 5

5.text: Damage per hit: MATK 250%, Detection Range: 5 x 5

description: Prerequisite : Cold Bolt Lv. 1, Lightning Bolt Lv. 1
Description : Can only be used when there is water within the caster’s nearby area.
Attacks the target repeatedly based on the number of water-filled cells within range, dealing Water Magical Damage.
The detection range increases with skill level, and the skill can also be used on areas affected by skills such as Deluge.
[Lv 1] Damage per hit: MATK 130%, Detection Range: 1 x 1
[Lv 2] Damage per hit: MATK 160%, Detection Range: 3 x 3
[Lv 3] Damage per hit: MATK 190%, Detection Range: 3 x 3
[Lv 4] Damage per hit: MATK 220%, Detection Range: 5 x 5
[Lv 5] Damage per hit: MATK 250%, Detection Range: 5 x 5

87.name: Ice Wall
description: Prerequisite : Stone Curse Lv. 1, Frost Diver Lv. 1
Description : Creates a 1 x 5 wall of ice with Neutral-Property on the ground.
Enemies cannot pass through the wall, but ranged attacks such as Arrow attacks can pass through it.
The wall has durability based on skill level, which decreases by 50 per second after placement and disappears when it reaches 0.

88.name: Frost Nova
description: Prerequisite : Frost Diver Lv. 1, Ice Wall Lv. 1
Description : Deals Water Magical Damage to enemies within a 5 x 5 area around the caster and inflicts [Status Ailment : Frozen].
The base chance to inflict Frozen and its duration increase with skill level.

89.name: Storm Gust
description: Prerequisite : Frost Diver Lv. 1, Jupitel Thunder Lv. 3
Description : Unleashes a blizzard over an 11 x 11 area at the targeted location, dealing Water Magical Damage to enemies.
Damage is increased based on the caster’s INT. The blizzard lasts 4.5 seconds, striking once every 0.45 seconds and knocking targets back by 2 cells.
Damaged targets have a chance to be inflicted with [Status Ailment : Frozen], and while Frozen is active, they do not take damage.

90.name: Earth Spike
description: Description : Causes spikes of earth to erupt beneath the target, dealing Earth Magical Damage equal to MATK 200%.
Damage is increased based on the caster’s INT, and the number of hits increases with skill level.

91.name: Heaven's Drive
description: Description : Causes the ground within a 5 x 5 area at the targeted location to erupt, dealing Earth Magical Damage equal to MATK 200% to targets within range.
Hidden targets underground are also damaged and revealed.
Damage is further increased based on the caster’s INT, and the number of hits increases with skill level.

92.name: Quagmire
description: Description : Creates a muddy swamp in a 5 x 5 area at the targeted location, reducing the movement speed and AGI and DEX of targets within range by half.
AGI and DEX can be reduced up to a maximum of 50, and players are affected at only half effectiveness.
If the target is under certain movement speed–increasing or ASPD-increasing effects, those effects are removed.
Up to 3 instances of Quagmire can be active at once. If placement exceeds the limit, a new one can only be placed after an existing Quagmire fully expires.

93.name: Sense
description: Description : Displays detailed information about the targeted monster to the caster and the caster’s party members.

8003.name: Brain Surgery

1.text: Max SP +1% / Increase SP Recovery +3% / Healing Hands +2%

2.text: Max SP +2% / Increase SP Recovery +6% / Healing Hands +4%

3.text: Max SP +3% / Increase SP Recovery +9% / Healing Hands +6%

4.text: Max SP +4% / Increase SP Recovery +12% / Healing Hands +8%

5.text: Max SP +5% / Increase SP Recovery +15% / Healing Hands +10%

description: Description : Increases brain capacity through Brain Surgery, boosting Max SP and SP recovery of the LIF homunculus.
Also increases the Heal effect of Healing Hands.
[Lv 1] Max SP +1% / Increase SP Recovery +3% / Healing Hands +2%
[Lv 2] Max SP +2% / Increase SP Recovery +6% / Healing Hands +4%
[Lv 3] Max SP +3% / Increase SP Recovery +9% / Healing Hands +6%
[Lv 4] Max SP +4% / Increase SP Recovery +12% / Healing Hands +8%
[Lv 5] Max SP +5% / Increase SP Recovery +15% / Healing Hands +10%

8011.name: Accelerated Flight

1.text: Improve Dodge 20 / Duration 60 sec / Cooldown 60 sec

2.text: Improve Dodge 30 / Duration 55 sec / Cooldown 75 sec

3.text: Improve Dodge 40 / Duration 50 sec / Cooldown 90 sec

4.text: Improve Dodge 50 / Duration 45 sec / Cooldown 105 sec

5.text: Improve Dodge 60 / Duration 40 sec / Cooldown 120 sec

description: Description : Temporarily pushes the homunculus’s FLEE Rate to its limits, greatly increasing evasion.
[Lv 1] Improve Dodge 20 / Duration 60 sec / Cooldown 60 sec
[Lv 2] Improve Dodge 30 / Duration 55 sec / Cooldown 75 sec
[Lv 3] Improve Dodge 40 / Duration 50 sec / Cooldown 90 sec
[Lv 4] Improve Dodge 50 / Duration 45 sec / Cooldown 105 sec
[Lv 5] Improve Dodge 60 / Duration 40 sec / Cooldown 120 sec

94.name: Iron Tempering
description: Description : Allows the creation of 1 Iron using 1 Iron Ore by consuming 1 Portable Furnace.
The success rate increases with skill level.
Success rate is further increased based on the caster’s DEX and LUK.

3031.name: Snow Flip
description: Pure white petals like snowflakes, cold to the touch.
Handle with care, as they may cause frostbite.
Cures Burn, Bleeding, Deep Sleep, and Sleep when used.

95.name: Steel Tempering
description: Description : Allows the creation of 1 Steel using 5 Iron and 1 Coal by consuming 1 Portable Furnace.
The success rate increases with skill level.
Success rate is further increased based on the caster’s DEX and LUK.

3043.name: Glast Heim Recall
description: Cannot be reused for 5 minutes after use.

6.name: Provoke
description: Description : Provokes the target, reducing defense based on VIT for players and reducing physical defense for monsters.
In exchange for reduced defense, the target's attack power increases. When used on monsters, draws their aggression toward the caster.
Does not work on Undead Monsters or boss monsters.

96.name: Enchanted Stone Craft
description: Description : Allows the creation of 1 elemental stone by consuming 10 elemental ores of the same property and 1 Portable Furnace.
The success rate increases with skill level.
Success rate is further increased based on the caster’s DEX and LUK.

8214.name: Arrow Repel
description: Description : Draws the bowstring to fire a powerful Arrow.
The target is knocked back 4 cells.

8230.name: Mental Cure
description: Description : Cures Confusion and Hallucination Status Ailment.

97.name: Research Oridecon
description: Description : Increases the success rate when crafting items using Oridecon.

98.name: Smith Dagger
description: Description : Allows the creation of Daggers by consuming 1 Hammer (Steel, Golden, or Oridecon Hammer).
Required materials and an Anvil must be in the caster’s inventory.
The success rate increases with skill level.
Success rate is further increased based on the caster’s DEX and LUK.

99.name: Smith Sword
description: Description : Allows the creation of One-handed Swords by consuming 1 Hammer (Steel, Golden, or Oridecon Hammer).
Required materials and an Anvil must be in the caster’s inventory.
The success rate increases with skill level.
Success rate is further increased based on the caster’s DEX and LUK.

100.name: Smith Two-handed Sword
description: Description : Allows the creation of Two-handed Swords by consuming 1 Hammer (Steel, Golden, or Oridecon Hammer).
Required materials and an Anvil must be in the caster’s inventory.
The success rate increases with skill level.
Success rate is further increased based on the caster’s DEX and LUK.

101.name: Smith Axe
description: Description : Allows the creation of Axes by consuming 1 Hammer (Steel, Golden, or Oridecon Hammer).
Required materials and an Anvil must be in the caster’s inventory.
The success rate increases with skill level.
Success rate is further increased based on the caster’s DEX and LUK.

102.name: Smith Mace
description: Description : Allows the creation of Maces by consuming 1 Hammer (Steel, Golden, or Oridecon Hammer).
Required materials and an Anvil must be in the caster’s inventory.
The success rate increases with skill level.
Success rate is further increased based on the caster’s DEX and LUK.

103.name: Smith Knuckle
description: Description : Allows the creation of Knuckles by consuming 1 Hammer (Steel, Golden, or Oridecon Hammer).
Required materials and an Anvil must be in the caster’s inventory.
The success rate increases with skill level.
Success rate is further increased based on the caster’s DEX and LUK.

104.name: Smith Spear
description: Description : Allows the creation of Spears by consuming 1 Hammer (Steel, Golden, or Oridecon Hammer).
Required materials and an Anvil must be in the caster’s inventory.
The success rate increases with skill level.
Success rate is further increased based on the caster’s DEX and LUK.

105.name: Hilt Binding
description: Description : Increases STR by 1 and Physical Damage by 4.
Increases the Duration of Adrenaline Rush, Power Thrust, and Weapon Perfection by 10%.

106.name: Ore Discovery
description: Prerequisite : Hilt Binding Lv. 1, Steel Tempering Lv. 1
Description : When defeating monsters, grants a chance to obtain Ore-type items.

107.name: Weaponry Research
description: Description : Improves weapon proficiency, increasing HIT.
Adds Physical Damage based on skill level when attacking.

108.name: Repair Weapon
description: Description : Repairs the target’s broken equipment.
Required materials vary by equipment type.

109.name: Skin Tempering
description: Description : Increases resistance to Fire, improving Fire-Property and Neutral-Property resistance.

110.name: Hammerfall
description: Description : Strikes the ground with a hammer, causing a shockwave.
Has a chance to inflict [Status Ailment : Stun] on enemies within a 5 x 5 cell area.
The success rate and Duration of Stun are reduced based on the target’s VIT.

10006.name: Guild Leadership
description: Description : Within a 5 x 5 cell area centered on the guild Pub Playmate, all Guildsman gain up to +5 STR.

111.name: Adrenaline Rush
description: For the duration, increases ASPD of the caster and party members wielding Axes or Maces.
If the target is a Blacksmith-class character, ASPD is increased further.

7.name: Magnum Break
description: Description : Deals Fire-Property physical damage to all enemies within a 5 x 5 cell area around the caster and knocks them back by 2 cells.
Additionally, adds 20% Fire-Property weapon damage to the caster’s attacks for 10 seconds.

112.name: Weapon Perfection
description: Prerequisite : Adrenaline Rush Lv. 2, Weaponry Research Lv. 2
Description : Removes weapon size penalties for the duration.

8215.name: Focused Arrow Strike
description: Description : Fires a powerful shot toward a designated point in a straight line, damaging all enemies in its path.
Has a chance to deal critical damage equal to the caster’s Critical Rate + 20.

113.name: Power Thrust
description: Description : Increases Physical Damage of the caster and nearby party members.
Adds bonus Physical Damage per skill level when attacking, with different values applied to the caster and party members.

114.name: Maximize Power
description: Prerequisite : Weapon Perfection Lv. 3, Power Thrust Lv. 2
Description : Draws out the weapon’s maximum potential, allowing attacks to deal maximum damage.
While active, SP is continuously consumed, and the skill must be used again to deactivate it.
SP does not naturally recover while this effect is active.

115.name: Skid Trap
description: Description : Uses 1 Deployable Trap to set a trap that causes enemies who step on it to slide in a designated direction.
Targets that slide are unable to move for 3 seconds.
If not triggered, the trap is removed when its active duration ends and returns as a Deployable Trap.

116.name: Land Mine
description: Description : Uses 1 Deployable Trap to set a trap that explodes when an enemy steps within a 3 x 3 cell area around it,
Damage increases based on skill level, the caster’s Base Level, DEX, and INT.
If not triggered, the trap is removed when its active duration ends and returns as a Deployable Trap.

117.name: Anklesnare
description: Description : Uses 1 Deployable Trap to set a trap that immobilizes enemies for a certain duration when they step within a 3 x 3 cell area.
The immobilization duration is reduced as the target’s AGI increases.
If not triggered, the trap is removed when its active duration ends and returns as a Deployable Trap.

118.name: Shockwave Trap
description: Description : Uses 2 Deployable Trap to set a trap that drains the target’s SP when stepped on within a 3 x 3 cell area.
If not triggered, the trap is removed when its active duration ends and returns as a Deployable Trap.

119.name: Sandman
description: Description : Uses 1 Deployable Trap to set a trap that inflicts [Status Ailment : Sleep] on the target that steps on it and on enemies within a surrounding 5 x 5 cell area.
If not triggered, the trap is removed when its active duration ends and returns as a Deployable Trap.
The chance to inflict Sleep is reduced based on the target’s Status Ailment resistance.

120.name: Flasher
description: Description : Uses 2 Deployable Trap to set a trap that emits a sudden flash when stepped on, inflicting [Status Ailment : Blind].
The chance to inflict Blind is always 100% regardless of skill level, but is reduced based on the target’s Status Ailment resistance.

121.name: Freezing Trap
description: Description : Uses 2 Deployable Trap to set a trap that deals special Water-Property damage and inflicts [Status Ailment : Frozen] when stepped on.
The chance to inflict Frozen is always 100%, but is reduced based on the target’s Status Ailment resistance.

122.name: Blast Mine
description: Prerequisite : Sandman Lv. 1, Land Mine Lv. 1, Freezing Trap Lv. 1
Description : Uses 2 Deployable Trap to set a trap that explodes either when stepped on within a 3 x 3 cell area or automatically when its active duration ends,
Blast Mine can be attacked and pushed to a different location before it explodes.

123.name: Claymore Trap
description: Prerequisite : Blast Mine Lv. 1, Shockwave Trap Lv. 1
Description : Uses 2 Deployable Trap to set a trap that explodes instantly when an enemy steps within a surrounding 5 x 5 cell area, dealing special Fire-Property damage.
Claymore Trap can also be detonated by directly attacking it.

124.name: Remove Trap
description: When a trap is removed, the trap item used for its installation is recovered.

125.name: Talkie Box
description: Prerequisite : Remove Trap Lv. 1, Shockwave Trap Lv. 1
Description : Consumes 1 Deployable Trap to set a trap that displays a preset message when a player steps within a surrounding 3 x 3 cell area.
The message is shown above the target’s head, and the trap is removed afterward.

126.name: Beastbane
description: Description : When attacking Brute- and Insect-type enemies, additional physical damage is added based on skill level.

127.name: Falconry Mastery
description: Description : Allows borrowing a hunting falcon from the Hunter guild.
Additionally, enables summoning a falcon using Falcon Whistle.

2042.name: Cantocandidus

1.text: Effect Range: 3 cells around the caster / Duration 120 sec

2.text: Effect Range: 7 cells around the caster / Duration 180 sec

3.text: Effect Range: 15 cells around the caster / Duration 240 sec

description: Description : Grants all nearby party members the Acolyte skill [Increase Agility] effect centered on the caster. The higher the caster’s Job Lv, the more AGI and ASPD (After Attack Delay reduction) are additionally increased.
[Lv 1] Effect Range: 3 cells around the caster / Duration 120 sec
[Lv 2] Effect Range: 7 cells around the caster / Duration 180 sec
[Lv 3] Effect Range: 15 cells around the caster / Duration 240 sec

8.name: Endure
description: Description : Allows the caster to continue moving and attacking while being hit for a certain duration. However, hit stun still occurs when taking damage from magic or skill attacks.
If the caster is hit 7 times or more while under the Endure status, the effect is removed. This effect does not apply in Siege.

128.name: Steel Crow
description: Description : Increases the damage dealt by falcon-based attacks.

129.name: Blitz Beat
description: Description : Commands the falcon to strike the target and enemies within a 3 x 3 cell area.
Falcon damage increases based on the caster’s AGI and DEX.
Additionally, basic attacks gain a chance to automatically trigger a falcon attack, with the activation chance increased by the caster’s LUK.
The falcon’s attack range is equal to the range of the learned Vulture's Eye skill plus 3 cells.

130.name: Detect
description: Prerequisite : Improve Concentration Lv. 1, Falconry Mastery Lv. 1
Description : Sends the falcon to the selected location to reveal hidden traps and concealed targets within a 7 x 7 cell area.

131.name: Spring Trap
description: Prerequisite : Remove Trap Lv. 1, Falconry Mastery Lv. 1
Description : Uses the falcon to instantly activate one of your deployed traps.

132.name: Righthand Mastery
description: Description : Restores the right-hand damage penalty when dual wielding.

133.name: Lefthand Mastery
description: Description : Restores the left-hand damage penalty when dual wielding.

134.name: Katar Mastery
description: Description : Increases physical damage when using Katar weapons.

135.name: Cloaking

1.text: Normal: Unavailable, Wall: 100%, SP -1 per 0.5 sec

2.text: Normal: Unavailable, Wall: 103%, SP -1 per 1.0 sec

description: Description : Moves unseen by using blind spots.
Movement speed increases along walls but decreases away from them.
Consumes 1 SP at intervals based on skill level and disables natural SP recovery.
Detected by Demon-type, Insect Monsters, and Boss monsters.
-After the effect ends, items cannot be picked up for 3 seconds.
[Lv 1] Normal: Unavailable, Wall: 100%, SP -1 per 0.5 sec
[Lv 2] Normal: Unavailable, Wall: 103%, SP -1 per 1.0 sec

136.name: Sonic Blow
description: Rapidly strikes the target to deal Melee Physical Damage.
Has a chance to inflict [Status Ailment : Stun].
Deals 50% more damage if the target’s HP is below 50%.

137.name: Grimtooth
description: Prerequisite : Cloaking Lv. 2, Sonic Blow Lv. 5
When using Grimtooth while under Hiding, deals Ranged Physical Damage to the target and enemies in a 3 x 3 cells area.
Against normal monsters, hit targets have their Movement Speed reduced by 50% for 1 second.

138.name: Enchant Poison
description: Description : Enchants the target’s weapon with Poison-Property.
Attacks with the enchanted weapon have a chance to inflict [Status Ailment : Poison].
The effect is removed if the weapon is unequipped or changed.

139.name: Poison React
description: Description : Assumes a counter stance against poison attacks.
When attacked by Poison-Property monsters, counterattacks once, dealing Melee Physical Damage.
If Double Attack is learned, its activation chance applies on the counter.
When attacked by non-poison monsters or players, automatically casts Envenom Lv. 5 a set number of times on the attacker.

140.name: Venom Dust
description: Description : Consumes 1 Red Gemstone to spread poison on the target cell and a 3 x 3 cells area.
Targets entering the area have a chance to be inflicted with [Status Ailment : Poison].
The chance is reduced by the target’s Status Ailment resistance.

141.name: Venom Splasher
description: Prerequisite : Poison React Lv. 5, Venom Dust Lv. 5
Description : Plants a timed explosive on the target.
After the delay, it explodes, dealing Melee Physical Damage and inflicting [Status Ailment : Poison] to enemies within a 5 x 5 cells area.
The poison chance is reduced by the target’s Status Ailment resistance.

142.name: First Aid
description: Prerequisite : Available after completing the quest.

2276.name: Axe Mastery
description: Description : Increases ATK and HIT when equipping an axe. Maces also receive a minor bonus.

2280.name: Axe Tornado
description: Description : Rapidly spins an axe to create a violent storm, dealing Melee Physical Damage to enemies around self.
Damage increases based on the caster’s Base Lv and VIT.

143.name: Play Dead
description: Prerequisite : Available after completing the quest., Novice-exclusive skill
Description : Feigns death to avoid enemy threats for 30 seconds.
The effect ends if hit by area attacks or affected by Provoke.

2288.name: Triangle Shot
description: Description : Fires Arrow at a single enemy, dealing Ranged Physical Damage.
Damage increases based on the caster’s Base Lv and AGI.

9.name: Increase SP Recovery
description: Description : Recovers additional SP every 10 seconds while standing still. The recovery amount increases based on a fixed value plus a percentage of MSP.
SP will not be recovered while moving or when penalties that prevent HP/SP recovery due to weight are applied.

144.name: HP Recovery While Moving
description: Prerequisite : Available after completing the quest.
Description : Allows HP recovery while moving, at 25% of the recovery rate while standing still.
Does not receive bonus recovery from Increase HP Recovery.

145.name: Fatal Blow
description: Prerequisite : Available after completing the quest.
Description : When using Bash at Lv. 6 or higher, has a chance to inflict [Status Ailment : Stun].
The chance increases with the level of Bash used and the character’s level.

146.name: Berserk
description: Prerequisite : Available after completing the quest.
Description : Enters a berserk state when HP falls to 25% or lower.
This state is equivalent to being affected by Provoke Lv. 10 and persists until the critical condition ends.
The effect is removed by skills or situations that cancel Provoke.

147.name: Arrow Crafting
description: Prerequisite : Available after completing the quest.
Description : Converts the selected item into Arrow.
The arrow type and quantity depend on the item used.
Cannot be used if current weight exceeds 70% for Merchant.

148.name: Arrow Repel
description: Prerequisite : Available after completing the quest.
Description : Fires an Arrow with great force.
Deals Ranged Physical Damage equal to ATK 150% and knocks the target back by 4 cells.

149.name: Sand Attack
description: Prerequisite : Available after completing the quest.
Description : Throws sand at the target, dealing Earth-Property melee physical damage equal to ATK 130%.
Has a chance to inflict [Status Ailment : Blind].

150.name: Back Slide
description: Prerequisite : Available after completing the quest.
Description : Slides backward by 5 cells, allowing you to evade enemy threats safely.

151.name: Find Stone
description: Prerequisite : Available after completing the quest.
Description : Picks up a stone from the ground.
Cannot be used if current weight exceeds 70%.

152.name: Stone Fling
description: Prerequisite : Available after completing the quest.
Description : Throws a stone at the target, dealing a fixed 50 Ranged Physical Damage that ignores DEF.
Consumes 1 stone and has a low chance to inflict Stun or Blind.

153.name: Cart Revolution
description: Prerequisite : Available after completing the quest.
Description : Can be used while a cart is equipped.
Strikes the target and enemies within 3 x 3 cells with special Melee Physical Damage.
Base damage is ATK 150% and increases with cart weight.

154.name: Change Cart
description: Prerequisite : Available after completing the quest.
Description : Can be used while a cart is equipped.
Changes the cart’s appearance based on your level.
More cart styles become available as your level increases.

155.name: Crazy Uproar
description: Prerequisite : Available after completing the quest.
Description : Lets out a powerful shout to boost morale.
For 5 min, increases STR by 4 and ATK by 30 for yourself and on-screen party members.

156.name: Holy Light
description: Prerequisite : Available after completing the quest.
Description : Strikes the target with holy light, dealing MATK 125% Holy Magical Damage.
Removes Kyrie Eleison from the target if active.

10008.name: Cold Heart
description: Description : Within a 5 x 5 cell area centered on the guild Pub Playmate, all Guildsman gain up to +5 AGI.

157.name: Energy Coat
description: Prerequisite : Available after completing the quest.
Description : Surrounds the caster with mental energy, reducing physical and magical damage taken.
Higher current SP increases damage reduction but consumes more SP per hit.

2536.name: Call of Guardian
description: Has a fixed casting time of 3 sec and cannot be reused for 5 minutes after use.

2544.name: Cart Decoration
description: Prerequisite : Available after completing the quest.
Description : Allows selection of various cute cart designs.

2548.name: Minimize Magic item attack rate
description: Description : Minimizes the magical item attack rate.

10.name: Sight
description: Description : Reveals all hidden targets within a 7 x 7 cell area around the caster for 10 seconds.

8201.name: Bash
description: Description : Strikes a target with a powerful blow, dealing heavy damage.
If Fatal Blow is learned, has a chance to inflict Stun at Skill Lv. 5 or higher.

8217.name: Brandish Spear
description: Description : Swings a spear in a wide arc, striking enemies in front.

8233.name: Berserk
description: Description : Automatically activates when HP falls to 25% or lower. While active, the effect is equivalent to Provoke Lv. 10 and remains until the critical condition ends. The effect is removed if Provoke is canceled by skills or conditions that negate it.

11.name: Napalm Beat
description: Description : Attacks a distant enemy using telekinetic force, dealing Ghost Magical Damage to the target and all enemies within a 3 x 3 cell area around it.
Damage is distributed among targets when multiple enemies are hit.

8005.name: Castling
description: Description : Instantly swaps positions with the homunculus.
Monsters attacking the player will target the homunculus instead.

8013.name: Caprice
description: Description : Randomly activates one Bolt-type skill.
The Bolt skill level is determined by the homunculus’s Caprice Skill Lv.

10009.name: Sharp Gaze
description: Description : Within a 5 x 5 cell area centered on the guild Pub Playmate, all Guildsman gain up to +5 DEX.

3032.name: Peony Mommy
description: Thick pink petals with a warm temperature, like a mother’s embrace.
Cures Frozen, Freeze, and Ice status when used.

3036.name: Magic Strings
description: Area of Effect : 7 cells around self
Description : Reduces Variable Casting Time and Global Delay for players within range.

3040.name: Wide Resurrection
description: Description : Revives an incapacitated player and all nearby players.

3044.name: Para Thanatos
description: Cannot be reused for 5 minutes after use.

12.name: Safety Wall
description: 2Prerequisite : Napalm Beat Lv. 7, Soul Strike Lv. 5
23Prerequisite : Napalm Beat Lv. 4, Soul Strike Lv. 3
Description : Creates a magical barrier at the designated location that blocks a fixed number of enemy attacks. The barrier disappears when its durability is depleted or when the Duration expires.
Only melee physical attacks are blocked. Casting this skill requires 1 Blue Gemstone.
The barrier’s durability is additionally increased based on the caster’s INT, Base Level, and MSP.
The first blocked hit may negate damage exceeding the barrier’s total durability.

8202.name: Magnum Break
description: Description : Deals Fire-Property splash damage to all nearby enemies and knocks them back.
For 10 sec after use, basic attacks gain +20% Fire-Property damage.
Consumes a small amount of HP when used.

8218.name: Clashing Spiral
description: Description : Thrusts a spear to unleash a spiraling, multi-hit attack with enhanced piercing power.
Damage increases with weapon weight and immobilizes the target for 1 sec.
Higher Skill Lv increases damage but also increases casting time.

8234.name: Decrease AGI
description: Description : Reduces the target’s movement speed and ASPD for a set duration.

13.name: Soul Strike
description: Description : Summons ancient spirits to directly strike the target, dealing Ghost Magical Damage equal to MATK 100%.
Deals additional damage to Undead-Property enemies.

210.name: Gank
description: Description : When performing a normal melee attack, has a chance to automatically attempt Steal on the target.
The activation chance increases with skill level and is affected by the learned level of Steal.

212.name: Back Stab
description: Description : Strikes the target from behind to deal Melee Physical Damage.
Damage is halved when used with a bow; when used with a dagger, the attack hits twice.
Grants a HIT bonus based on skill level when cast.

213.name: Stalk
description: Description : Allows movement while under Hiding.
Movement speed while hidden is slower than normal.

214.name: Sightless Mind
description: Description : Can only be used while under Hiding.
Ends Hiding and deals damage to enemies within 7 x 7 cells, with a chance to inflict Stun and Blind.
Damage increases based on the caster’s DEX and AGI.
Affected targets take increased damage for 10 sec (30%, or 15% for boss monsters).
Status ailment chance is reduced by the target’s resistance.

215.name: Divest Weapon
description: Description : Attempts to strip the target’s weapon.
In PvP, unequips the weapon and prevents re-equipping for a duration.
Against monsters, reduces ATK by 25% for a duration.
Success chance and Duration increase with skill level and the caster’s DEX, and are reduced by the target’s DEX.

216.name: Divest Shield
description: Description : Attempts to strip the target’s shield.
In PvP, unequips the shield and prevents re-equipping for a duration.
Against monsters, reduces DEF by 15% for a duration.
Success chance and Duration increase with skill level and the caster’s DEX, and are reduced by the target’s DEX.

217.name: Divest Armor
description: Description : Attempts to strip the target’s armor.
In PvP, unequips the armor and prevents re-equipping for a duration.
Against monsters, reduces VIT by 40% for a duration. This does not affect HP.
Success chance and Duration increase with skill level and the caster’s DEX, and are reduced by the target’s DEX.

218.name: Divest Helm
description: Description : Attempts to strip the target’s helm.
In PvP, unequips the helm and prevents re-equipping for a duration.
Against monsters, reduces INT by 40% for a duration. This does not affect SP.
Success chance and Duration increase with skill level and the caster’s DEX, and are reduced by the target’s DEX.

219.name: Snatch
description: Prerequisite : Sightless Mind Lv. 5, Back Stab Lv. 4
Description : Deals Melee Physical Damage to the target and warps both the caster and the target to a random location on the map.
Has no effect on boss monsters. Success chance increases with higher caster level and lower target level.

220.name: Scribble
description: Description : Consumes 1 Red Gemstone to place custom graffiti around the selected cell.
The caster can enter up to about 20 characters using English letters and numbers.
Only one Scribble can exist at a time.

10010.name: Battle Command
description: Description : Usable only in Siege Mode. Can only be used by the guild Pub Playmate. For 60 sec, increases STR, INT, and DEX of all Guildsman within sight by 5.

221.name: Piece
description: Description : When used on a guild flag, replaces the guild emblem with a random graffiti.
More graffiti types become available as skill level increases.
Consumes 1 Small Brush when used. (Not implemented)

222.name: Remover
description: Description : Removes graffiti applied by Piece and restores the flag to normal.
Consumes 1 Cleaning Cloth when used. (Not implemented)

5063.name: Let's Go Family
description: Description : Summons family members on the same map to the caster’s location.
Family members must be in the same party.
Cannot be used in areas where Teleport is unavailable.

223.name: Slyness
description: Description : If another Rogue Class player is sitting within 3 x 3 cells around you while you are sitting, monsters will not attack you or that Rogue.
Has no effect on boss monsters.

14.name: Cold Bolt
description: Description : Fires an icy Arrow at the target, dealing Water Magical Damage equal to MATK 100%.
Damage is further increased based on the caster’s INT.

224.name: Haggle
description: Description : Reduces purchase prices at normal NPC shops.

8203.name: Bowling Bash
description: Description : Crashes enemies into each other to attack multiple targets at once.

8219.name: Defending Aura
description: Description : Significantly reduces damage from ranged physical attacks.
Damage reduction scales with Skill Lv, but movement speed and ASPD are reduced while active.
Using Defending Aura again while active cancels the effect.

225.name: Plagiarism
description: Description : Increases ASPD based on skill level (reduces After Attack Delay).
Allows you to memorize and use the last skill that hit you (excluding monster-only skills).
The maximum usable level of the memorized skill increases with skill level, but cannot exceed the original skill’s max level.
Memorized skills do not count as learned skills and are not affected by skill tree requirements or level-boosting effects.
Expanded classes and Transcendent 2nd class skills cannot be memorized.

226.name: Axe Mastery
description: Description : Adds a damage bonus to physical attacks when using an axe or one-handed sword.

5064.name: Love Conquers Death
description: Description : Revives an incapacitated family member with 30% HP.
Has no effect if the target is Undead.

227.name: Potion Research
description: Description : Increases the effectiveness of HP recovery potions and assists with potion crafting.

228.name: Prepare Potion
description: Description : Creates potions and chemical items. Using this skill consumes 1 Mortar Bowl, and the corresponding potion manual is required to craft each potion.

229.name: Bomb
description: Description : Throws 1 Molotov Cocktail at the target ground, dealing Fire-Property Melee Physical Damage over time to enemies within a 3 x 3 cell area.
The flames created by Bomb do not cause knockback and have a chance to destroy the target’s weapon.
Damage per hit increases based on the skill level of Potion Research.

230.name: Acid Terror
description: Description : Throws 1 Acid Bottle at the target, dealing Ranged Physical Damage and having a chance to inflict [Status Ailment : Bleeding] or destroy the target’s armor.
As the skill level increases, the chance to inflict Bleeding or destroy armor increases.
Damage scales with the skill level of Potion Research, and the chance to inflict Bleeding is reduced by the target’s Status Ailment resistance.

231.name: Aid Potion
description: Description : Throws a potion to recover HP of a party member, Guildsman, or Homunculus.
The recovery effect increases based on skill level, and higher levels allow the use of additional potion types.
Only standard potions can be used, and ranking effects do not apply when using Aid Potion.
When used on a Homunculus, the Heal effect is significantly increased.

232.name: Summon Flora
description: Description : Consumes 1 Plant Bottle to summon Plant Monsters that attack enemies on the targeted ground.
Summoned monsters automatically disappear after a certain time.
Their MHP varies depending on skill level.
Different monsters are summoned by skill level, and only one type can be active at a time.
Lower skill levels allow more monsters to be summoned, while Lv. 5 allows only one monster.

233.name: Summon Marine Sphere
description: Description : Consumes 1 Marine Sphere Bottle to summon a Marine Sphere on the targeted ground.
When attacked, the summoned Marine Sphere moves in the opposite direction of the attacker and triggers a self-destruction skill.
Up to 3 can be summoned at once. In PvP-enabled areas, the explosion can also damage the caster and allies.

234.name: Alchemical Weapon
description: Description : Consumes 1 Coating Agent to make the target’s weapon unbreakable and immune to Strip effects for a certain duration.

235.name: Synthesized Shield
description: Description : Consumes 1 Coating Agent to make the target’s shield unbreakable and immune to Strip effects for a certain duration.

236.name: Synthetic Armor
description: Description : Consumes 1 Coating Agent to make the target’s armor unbreakable and immune to Strip effects for a certain duration.

237.name: Biochemical Helm
description: Description : Consumes 1 Coating Agent to make the target’s helm unbreakable and immune to Strip effects for a certain duration.

3042.name: Prontera Recall
description: Cannot be reused for 15 minutes after use.

3037.name: Lady Luck
description: Area of Effect : 7 cells around self
Description : Increases CRIT of players within range.

238.name: Bioethics
description: Prerequisite : Available after completing the quest.
Description : Has no direct effect. This skill simply marks the beginning of the skill tree required to create a Homunculus.
For those who handle precious life, however, Bioethics can never be emphasized enough.

239.name: Biotechnology
description: Description : Learns the fundamentals of life creation.
Increases the success chance of using Creature Creation and increases your Homunculus’ MHP.

15.name: Frost Diver
description: Description : Deals Water Magical Damage to the target and has a chance to inflict [Status Ailment : Frozen].
The chance and duration of Frozen are affected by the target’s level, magic defense, and LUK.

240.name: Creature Creation
description: Description : Creates a new life item, Embryo, using the origin of life.
Base success chance increases by skill level.

241.name: Cultivation
description: Description : Cultivates an Embryo to create a Homunculus.
Success or failure is determined by chance, and the base success rate increases by skill level.
Cannot be used if you already have an active Homunculus.
A successfully created Homunculus automatically becomes your active Homunculus.

3034.name: Yggdrasil Dust
description: Dust fragments once clinging to the leaves of the World Tree, which reveal purifying power when gathered and used.
Cures Petrification, Blind, Curse, Poison, Decrease Agility, and Grampus Morph when used.

47.name: Arrow Shower
description: Description : Fires a single Arrow at the designated location, dealing Ranged Physical Damage to enemies within a 3×3 cell area.
Targets hit are additionally knocked back by 2 cells from the center.
The base range of Arrow Shower is 9 cells.

242.name: Flame Control
description: Description : Controls flames using a furnace.
Increases the success chance of using Cultivation and increases Fire property resistance of the skill user.

3035.name: Return to Eclage
description: Has a fixed casting time of 3 sec and cannot be reused for 5 minutes after use.

243.name: Call Homunculus
description: Description : Calls your Homunculus or creates a new one.
To recall a Homunculus, it must have been previously created and be in a dormant state via Vaporize.
To create a Homunculus, an Embryo is required.

48.name: Double Attack
description: Description : When attacking with a dagger, grants a chance to perform a double attack.
The activation chance increases with skill level, and a bonus to HIT is also applied.
When using Katar-type weapons, this skill affects damage dealt by the left hand.

244.name: Vaporize
description: Description : Sends your Homunculus into a resting state.
Can only be used when the Homunculus has at least 80% of its Max HP.
A Homunculus in the Vaporize state can be recalled using Call Homunculus.

245.name: Drillmaster
description: Description : Increases your Homunculus’ attack power.

246.name: Heal Homunculus
