description: Description : Recovers HP of Homunculus-type creatures.
The Heal effect is the same as the Heal skill used by Acolyte.

2535.name: Open Buying Store
description: Description : Opens a simple buying shop at the current location to purchase various items.

247.name: Homunculus Resurrection
description: Description : Revives a Homunculus that disappeared due to incapacitation.

248.name: Faith
description: Description : Increases MHP by 200 per skill level and grants Holy property resistance.

46.name: Double Strafe
description: Description : Fires a single Arrow at the target, striking twice.
The base range of Double Strafe is 9 cells.

249.name: Guard
description: For the duration, has a chance to block incoming physical damage.
Triggers a brief delay when a block occurs.
The effect ends when the shield is unequipped, or when used again while Guard is active.

250.name: Smite
description: Strikes the enemy with a shield, dealing Melee Physical Damage, knocking the target back, and has a chance to inflict Stun.
The chance to inflict Stun is reduced by the target’s status ailment resistance.

10001.name: Contract With Kafra
description: Description : Forms a contract with the Kafra Headquarters in Aldebaran. Upon contracting, the guild can hire a guild-exclusive Kafra Employee in the stronghold.

8006.name: Amistr Bulwark

1.text: Player DEF +5 / Homunculus DEF +10 / Duration 40 sec

2.text: Player DEF +7 / Homunculus DEF +15 / Duration 35 sec

3.text: Player DEF +10 / Homunculus DEF +20 / Duration 30 sec

4.text: Player DEF +12 / Homunculus DEF +25 / Duration 25 sec

5.text: Player DEF +15 / Homunculus DEF +30 / Duration 20 sec

[Lv 1] Player DEF +5 / Homunculus DEF +10 / Duration 40 sec
[Lv 2] Player DEF +7 / Homunculus DEF +15 / Duration 35 sec
[Lv 3] Player DEF +10 / Homunculus DEF +20 / Duration 30 sec
[Lv 4] Player DEF +12 / Homunculus DEF +25 / Duration 25 sec
[Lv 5] Player DEF +15 / Homunculus DEF +30 / Duration 20 sec

8014.name: Chaotic Blessings
description: Description : Randomly casts Heal on one of three targets: an enemy, the homunculus itself, or the owner.
The target is selected based on the following probabilities.

8210.name: Land Mine
description: Description : Sets a trap that explodes when stepped on, dealing damage.

252.name: Shield Reflect
description: For the duration, reflects a portion of incoming Melee Physical Damage Taken back to the attacker.
The effect is removed if the shield is unequipped during Duration.

1011.name: Charming Wink
description: Prerequisite : Available after completing the quest.
Description : Sends a charming wink to distract the target, with a high chance to inflict Status Ailment Confusion and Hallucination. Has no effect on boss monsters.

10011.name: Regeneration
description: Description : Usable only in Siege Mode. Can only be used by the guild Pub Playmate. Increases HP/SP recovery speed of all Guildsman within sight.

253.name: Holy Cross
description: Description : Strikes the target with a holy cross, dealing Holy-Property Melee Physical Damage and has a chance to inflict Blind.
The chance to inflict Blind is reduced by the target’s status ailment resistance.
Damage increases based on the caster’s VIT, and is further increased when a spear-type weapon is equipped.

375.name: Soul Siphon
description: Prerequisite : Cast Cancel Lv. 5, Magic Rod Lv. 3, Dispell Lv. 3
Description : Has a chance to reduce the target’s SP to 0.
When using Soul Siphon at Lv. 5, deals damage equal to twice the target’s remaining SP at the same time.
If the skill fails, the effect is reflected back to the caster.
This skill can only be used in PvP and Siege modes.

10003.name: Strengthen Guardians
description: Description : Enhances deployed Guardians. Each skill level increases Guardian ATK and ASPD.

254.name: Grand Cross
description: Prerequisite : Faith Lv. 10, Holy Cross Lv. 6
Description : Calls down divine judgment in a large cross-shaped area centered on the caster three times, dealing special Holy Magical Damage to targets within range.
Damage is affected by both ATK and MATK, and consumes 20% of current HP.
Casting is not interrupted when taking damage.
Undead and Demon Monsters, excluding Boss monsters, are inflicted with Blind.
The chance to inflict Blind is reduced by the target’s status ailment resistance.

374.name: Soul Exhale
description: Prerequisite : Magic Rod Lv. 3, Spell Breaker Lv. 2
Description : Exchanges the caster’s SP with the target’s SP.
Both parties receive 50% of the exchanged amount.
SP gained through this exchange cannot exceed MAXSP.

8235.name: Scapegoat
description: Description : The mercenary transfers all remaining HP to the summoner and dies. Any excess HP is lost.

373.name: Indulge

1.text: Restores SP equal to 10% of the reduced HP

2.text: Restores SP equal to 20% of the reduced HP

3.text: Restores SP equal to 30% of the reduced HP

4.text: Restores SP equal to 40% of the reduced HP

5.text: Restores SP equal to 50% of the reduced HP

description: Prerequisite : Increase SP Recovery Lv. 1, Magic Rod Lv. 1
Description : Reduces the caster’s HP by 10% and converts the reduced amount into SP.
[Lv 1] Restores SP equal to 10% of the reduced HP
[Lv 2] Restores SP equal to 20% of the reduced HP
[Lv 3] Restores SP equal to 30% of the reduced HP
[Lv 4] Restores SP equal to 40% of the reduced HP
[Lv 5] Restores SP equal to 50% of the reduced HP

255.name: Sacrifice
description: Prerequisite : Resistant Souls Lv. 4, Shield Reflect Lv. 5
Description : Redirects all damage taken by a designated party member to the caster.
The level difference between the target and caster must not exceed 16.
The effect is canceled if the target moves out of range, changes maps, or upon death.
Since damage is taken in place of the target, their casting is not interrupted when attacked.
Cannot be used on targets of the same Crusader Class.

1.name: Basic Skill
description: Allows use of basic interface-related functions.
Enables item trading with other characters.
Right-click the character you wish to trade with to use.
Use Alt+0–9, Ctrl+1, -, =, and \ to perform emotions. Additional emotions can be used with Alt+L.
Sit in place to increase HP recovery speed.
Use by pressing the Insert key or the /sit command.
Allows creation of a chat room. Use with Alt+C.
Allows joining a party created by another player.
Allows access to storage through a Kafra Employee.
Use with /create [Party Name]. Party options can be adjusted with Alt+Z.
Allows advancement to a first job class.

2.text: Catalyst consumption: On use, Petrification chance: 28%

Starting from skill level 6, Red Gemstone is only consumed if the skill is successfully cast.
The chance and duration of Petrification are affected by the target’s level, magic defense, and LUK.

256.name: Resistant Souls
description: Description : For Duration, increases resistance against Demon Monsters and Holy Property Resistance.
Also increases resistance to Stun, Petrify, Curse, and Confusion.

8212.name: Freezing Trap
description: Description : Sets a trap that inflicts Frozen on enemies who step on it.

8204.name: Parry
description: Description : Blocks incoming attacks with a sword.
A successful block negates damage and cancels one attack.

8220.name: Guard
description: Description : For the skill Duration, has a chance to block incoming melee and ranged physical attacks.
Each successful Guard causes 0.3 sec of hit delay, which is reduced as Skill Lv increases.

8236.name: Lex Divina
description: Description : Inflicts Silence on the target for a set duration.

259.name: Iron Fists
description: Description : When attacking with bare hands or Knuckle-type weapons, increases physical damage by an additional amount based on skill level.

260.name: Spiritual Cadence
description: Description : While sitting, recovers additional HP and SP every 10 sec.
When weight exceeds 70% in the Merchant state, recovery occurs every 20 sec.
Recovery per 10 sec is as follows:

261.name: Summon Spirit Sphere
description: Description : Condenses energy to form Spirit Spheres.
Spirit Spheres last for 10 min and affect skill usage.
Each Spirit Sphere increases physical damage by 3.

262.name: Spiritual Sphere Absorption
description: Description : Absorbs Spirit Sphere from yourself or a party member to recover SP.
In PvP and Guild Battles, can also absorb Spirit Spheres from other Monk Class.
When used on monsters, has a 20% chance to recover SP based on the monster’s level.
Does not affect Boss monsters or Guardians.

263.name: Raging Trifecta Blow
description: Description : Basic attacks have a 30% chance to trigger a triple-hit attack.
If Raging Quadruple Blow is learned, a 0.3 sec delay is applied after Raging Trifecta Blow activates, allowing the use of Raging Quadruple Blow.

265.name: Flee
description: Description : Increases FLEE Rate based on skill level.

266.name: Occult Impaction
description: Description : Consumes 1 Spirit Sphere to deal special Melee Physical Damage.
Damage increases with the target’s equipment defense.
When used on a target in Root, skill damage increases by 50%.

267.name: Throw Spirit Sphere
description: Description : Consumes 1 Spirit Sphere to deal Ranged Physical Damage.
When used on a target in Root, damage increases by 50%.

268.name: Mental Strength
description: Description : Consumes 5 Spirit Sphere to reduce all damage taken by 90%.
While active, cannot use skills, and movement speed and ASPD are reduced.

269.name: Root
description: Prerequisite : Flee Lv. 5, Summon Spirit Sphere Lv. 5
Description : Consumes 1 Spirit Sphere to restrain the attacking target, immobilizing both the caster and target for 10 sec.
During Duration, both cannot act; if either becomes incapacitated, the other can move again.
Higher skill levels allow certain skills to be used while restraining the target.
Duration is reduced when used on Boss monsters.
Guillotine Fist requires the Fury state and at least 1 Spirit Sphere.

270.name: Fury
description: Description : Detonates 5 Spirit Sphere to increase CRIT for 180 sec.
While in Fury, natural SP recovery is reduced by 50%.

1007.name: Create Elemental Converter
description: Prerequisite : Available after completing the quest.
Description : Creates Elemental Converter items. Can create four types: Water, Wind, Earth, and Fire-Property.
[Converter (Water)] Crystal Blue x1 + Empty Scroll x1
[Converter (Wind)] Wind of Verdure x1 + Empty Scroll x1
[Converter (Earth)] Green Live x1 + Empty Scroll x1
[Converter (Fire)] Red Blood x1 + Empty Scroll x1

271.name: Guillotine Fist
description: Prerequisite : Fury Lv. 3, Throw Spirit Sphere Lv. 3
Description : Can only be used while in the Fury state.
Consumes all remaining SP and all Spirit Sphere to deal special physical damage based on SP consumed.
After use, Fury is canceled and SP cannot be recovered for a short time.

17.name: Fire Ball
description: Description : Hurls a fireball at the target, dealing Fire Magical Damage to the target and enemies within a 5 x 5 cell area.
Damage differs between the center area (3 x 3 cells) and the outer area (5 x 5 cells).

272.name: Raging Quadruple Blow
description: Description : Can be used during the delay after Raging Trifecta Blow activates.
Strikes the target 4 times for Melee Physical Damage.
When using Knuckle-class weapons, hits 6 times with double damage.
After learning Raging Thrust, a 0.3 sec delay is applied before it can be used.

273.name: Raging Thrust
description: Description : Can be used during the delay after Raging Quadruple Blow activates.
Consumes 1 Spirit Sphere to smash the target for Melee Physical Damage.
Damage increases based on the caster’s STR.
After learning Guillotine Fist, a 0.3 sec delay is applied before it can be used.
Using Guillotine Fist after this skill requires the Fury state and at least 1 Spirit Sphere.

8012.name: S.B.R.44
description: Description : Sacrifices the homunculus’s accumulated intimacy to deal heavy damage to an enemy.

274.name: Study
description: Description : Increases physical damage when attacking with Book-class weapons.
Also increases ASPD while a Book-class weapon is equipped.

8232.name: Provoke
description: Description : Provokes a target, lowering DEF while increasing ATK. Ineffective on Undead enemies.

275.name: Cast Cancel
description: Description : Can only be used while casting a spell.
Immediately cancels the current cast in exchange for consuming SP of the casting skill.
SP consumption is reduced as skill level increases.

276.name: Magic Rod
description: Description : When used at the moment a targeted offensive spell would deal damage, negates the damage and absorbs the spell’s SP cost.
If the caster uses Spell Breaker and it is absorbed by Magic Rod, the caster loses 20% SP.

277.name: Spell Breaker
description: Description : Can be used on a target that is casting.
Cancels the cast and absorbs the SP cost of the spell.
Also drains HP equal to 2% of the target’s MHP; at Lv. 5, absorbs half of the HP drained.
HP drain does not apply to Boss monsters or Guardians, and has a 10% success rate on Boss monsters.

278.name: Free Cast
description: Description : Allows movement and attacks while casting spells, but fixes movement speed and ASPD.
Movement speed and ASPD vary by skill level.

8004.name: Mental Charge

1.text: Duration 1 min / VIT +30 / INT +20 / Cooldown 10 min

2.text: Duration 3 min / VIT +60 / INT +40 / Cooldown 15 min

3.text: Duration 5 min / VIT +90 / INT +60 / Cooldown 20 min

description: Description : Increases the homunculus’s INT and VIT, and converts normal attacks to deal damage based on MATK.
Effect ends after a maximum of 5 min, and HP/SP are set to 10 when the effect ends.
[Lv 1] Duration 1 min / VIT +30 / INT +20 / Cooldown 10 min
[Lv 2] Duration 3 min / VIT +60 / INT +40 / Cooldown 15 min
[Lv 3] Duration 5 min / VIT +90 / INT +60 / Cooldown 20 min

279.name: Hindsight
description: Description : Select one learned magic skill.
When performing basic physical attacks, the selected skill has a chance to activate automatically without casting.
The triggered skill activates at half of the Hindsight skill level and consumes 2/3 of its normal SP cost.
Only learned skills can be selected, and available magic increases with skill level.

280.name: Endow Blaze
description: Prerequisite : Fire Bolt Lv. 1, Study Lv. 5
Endows the target’s weapon with Fire-Property for the duration and increases Fire Magical Damage.
Can be used on self or party members.

281.name: Endow Tsunami
description: Prerequisite : Cold Bolt Lv. 1, Study Lv. 5
Endows the target’s weapon with Water-Property for the duration and increases Water Magical Damage.
Can be used on self or party members.

282.name: Endow Tornado
description: Prerequisite : Lightning Bolt Lv. 1, Study Lv. 5
Endows the target’s weapon with Wind-Property for the duration and increases Wind Magical Damage.
Can be used on self or party members.

283.name: Endow Quake
description: Prerequisite : Stone Curse Lv. 1, Study Lv. 5
Endows the target’s weapon with Earth-Property for the duration and increases Earth Magical Damage.
Can be used on self or party members.

284.name: Dragonology
description: Description : Increases resistance to Dragon Monsters.
Increases physical and magical damage against Dragon Monsters.
Partially ignores their magic defense and increases INT.

285.name: Volcano
description: Creates a Volcano zone in a 7 x 7 area around the target.
Increases Fire-Property damage dealt within the area.
Increases ATK and MATK of targets within the area.
Ice Wall cannot be used in this area.
Cannot overlap with other Sage ground skills.
Duration is equal to skill level in minutes.
Recasting Volcano, Deluge, or Whirlwind during Duration does not consume Blue Gemstone.

286.name: Deluge
description: Creates a Deluge zone in a 7 x 7 area around the target.
Increases Water-Property damage dealt within the area.
Increases MHP of targets within the area.
Aqua Benedicta and Waterball can be used in this area.
Using Waterball reduces the Deluge area by the skill’s detection range.
Cannot overlap with other Sage ground skills.
Duration equals skill level in minutes.
Recasting Volcano, Deluge, or Whirlwind during Duration does not consume Blue Gemstone.

287.name: Whirlwind
description: Creates a Whirlwind zone in a 7 x 7 area around the target.
Increases Wind-Property damage dealt within the area.
Increases FLEE Rate of targets within the area.
Extends Fire Wall Duration by 1.5x in this area.
Cannot overlap with other Sage ground skills.
Duration equals skill level in minutes.
Recasting Volcano, Deluge, or Whirlwind during Duration does not consume Blue Gemstone.

18.name: Fire Wall
description: Description : Creates a wall of fire that deals Fire Magical Damage equal to MATK 50% to approaching enemies and knocks them back by 2 cells.
Up to 3 walls can be placed at the same time.

288.name: Land Protector
description: Prerequisite : Volcano Lv. 3, Deluge Lv. 3, Whirlwind Lv. 3
Description : Consumes 1 Yellow Gemstone and 1 Blue Gemstone.
Prevents any magic from being placed within the area around the target cell.
Any existing ground magic in the created area is removed on cast.
Cannot overlap with other Sage ground skills.

289.name: Dispell
description: Removes all magical effects applied to the target with a certain chance.
Success chance is affected by the target’s magic defense.
At Lv. 5, the effect succeeds with 100% chance regardless of the target’s magic defense.

291.name: Mono Cell
description: Effect : Transforms the target into the monster ‘PORING’ for a certain duration.
Note : Can only be activated via Hocus-pocus

292.name: Class Change
description: Effect : Transforms the target into a boss monster for a certain duration.
Note : Can only be activated via Hocus-pocus

293.name: Monster Chant
description: Effect : Same effect as Dead Branch.
Note : Can only be activated via Hocus-pocus

294.name: Grampus Morph
description: Effect : Changes the target’s face type to ‘Orc’ for a certain duration.
Note : Can only be activated via Hocus-pocus

295.name: Grim Reaper
description: Effect : Forces the target to use Suicide. Targets affected by Suicide grant no EXP or items.
Note : Can only be activated via Hocus-pocus

296.name: Gold Digger
description: Effect : Obtains Zeny equal to the target’s Lv × 100.
Note : Can only be activated via Hocus-pocus

297.name: Beastly Hypnosis
description: Effect : If the target is a tamable monster, attempts to tame it.
Note : Can only be activated via Hocus-pocus

299.name: Gravity
description: Effect : Displays an effect above the target’s head. The effect is the logo of (Corp.) Gravity.
Note : Can only be activated via Hocus-pocus

300.name: Leveling
description: Note : Can only be activated via Hocus-pocus

2054.name: Duple Light

1.text: Physical Damage 550% / Magical Damage 880% / Duration 90 sec

2.text: Physical Damage 600% / Magical Damage 960% / Duration 120 sec

3.text: Physical Damage 650% / Magical Damage 1040% / Duration 150 sec

4.text: Physical Damage 700% / Magical Damage 1120% / Duration 180 sec

5.text: Physical Damage 750% / Magical Damage 1200% / Duration 210 sec

6.text: Physical Damage 800% / Magical Damage 1280% / Duration 240 sec

7.text: Physical Damage 850% / Magical Damage 1360% / Duration 270 sec

8.text: Physical Damage 900% / Magical Damage 1440% / Duration 300 sec

9.text: Physical Damage 950% / Magical Damage 1520% / Duration 330 sec

10.text: Physical Damage 1000% / Magical Damage 1600% / Duration 360 sec

description: Description : Summons two holy lights that deal additional damage to the target when performing melee attacks.
[Lv 1] Physical Damage 550% / Magical Damage 880% / Duration 90 sec
[Lv 2] Physical Damage 600% / Magical Damage 960% / Duration 120 sec
[Lv 3] Physical Damage 650% / Magical Damage 1040% / Duration 150 sec

[Lv 9] Physical Damage 950% / Magical Damage 1520% / Duration 330 sec
[Lv 10] Physical Damage 1000% / Magical Damage 1600% / Duration 360 sec

301.name: Suicide
description: Effect : Immediately becomes incapacitated. EXP loss and all penalties are identical to normal incapacitation.
Note : Can only be activated via Hocus-pocus

305.name: Encore
description: Description : Recasts the last song or dance used.
Performance, Dance, and Ensemble skills can be used at half their normal SP cost.
If the previously used skill cannot be recast, only the skill activation occurs and the cooldown is applied.

2445.name: Spell Fist
description: Description : When used while casting Fire, Cold, or Lightning Bolt, the bolt casting is Middle, concentrating magic power into the caster’s hands.
While active, basic attacks have a chance to deal bolt magic damage to the target.
Higher Skill Lv increases the additional damage. Effect ends when Duration expires.

309.name: Battle Theme
description: Target : 31 x 31 cells around self (self and party members within range)
Description : Increases ATK and DEF of allies within range based on the skill level for the duration.
Cannot overlap with other Ensemble skills.
To activate an Ensemble skill, a Bard and Dancer must be within 9 x 9 cells of each other.
After activation, the caster and partner suffer Ensemble Aftereffect for 10 sec (unable to use skills, reduced movement speed, and reduced ASPD).

264.name: Snap
description: Prerequisite : Fury Lv. 3, Raging Thrust Lv. 3, Mental Strength Lv. 3
Description : Consumes 1 Spirit Sphere to instantly move to the selected cell.
Fails if the path between the current location and the target cell is blocked.
Does not consume a Spirit Sphere while in Fury.
Cannot use Guillotine Fist for 2 sec after using Snap.

313.name: Acoustic Rhythm
description: Target : 31 x 31 cells around self (self and party members within range)
Description : Increases Earth, Water, Fire, and Wind resistance of party members within range based on the skill level.
Also increases resistance to Blind, Petrification, Frozen, Stun, Curse, Sleep, Silence, and Confusion.
Cannot overlap with other Ensemble skills.
To activate an Ensemble skill, a Bard and Dancer must be within 9 x 9 cells of each other.
After activation, the caster and partner suffer Ensemble Aftereffect for 10 sec (unable to use skills, reduced movement speed, and reduced ASPD).

10012.name: Restoration
description: Description : Usable only in Siege Mode. Can only be used by the guild Pub Playmate. Restores HP and SP of all Guildsman within sight up to 90% of Max HP.

315.name: Music Lessons

1.text: Instrument Damage +3, After Attack Delay -1%, MSP +1%

2.text: Instrument Damage +6, After Attack Delay -2%, MSP +2%

3.text: Instrument Damage +9, After Attack Delay -3%, MSP +3%

4.text: Instrument Damage +12, After Attack Delay -4%, MSP +4%

5.text: Instrument Damage +15, After Attack Delay -5%, MSP +5%

6.text: Instrument Damage +18, After Attack Delay -6%, MSP +6%

7.text: Instrument Damage +21, After Attack Delay -7%, MSP +7%

10.text: Instrument Damage +30, After Attack Delay -10%, MSP +10%

description: Description : Improves instrument combat proficiency and mental focus.
ATK and After Attack Delay bonuses apply only while an instrument is equipped.
[Lv 1] Instrument Damage +3, After Attack Delay -1%, MSP +1%
[Lv 2] Instrument Damage +6, After Attack Delay -2%, MSP +2%
[Lv 3] Instrument Damage +9, After Attack Delay -3%, MSP +3%

[Lv 9] Instrument Damage +27, After Attack Delay -9%, MSP +9%
[Lv 10] Instrument Damage +30, After Attack Delay -10%, MSP +10%

316.name: Melody Strike
description: Fires a powerful arrow twice, dealing Ranged Physical Damage.
Damage increases with the caster’s INT.
Attack property follows the equipped Arrow.

2545.name: Max Physical item attack rate
description: Description : Maximizes the physical item attack rate.

319.name: Perfect Tablature
description: Target : 31 x 31 cells around self (self and party members within range).
Description : Increases FLEE and Perfect Dodge for the caster and nearby party members.
Does not stack with other performance skills.

20.name: Lightning Bolt
description: Description : Calls down a bolt of lightning on the target, dealing Wind Magical Damage equal to MATK 100%.
Damage is further increased based on the caster’s INT.

320.name: Impressive Riff
description: Target : 31 x 31 cells around self (self and party members within range).
Description : Increases ASPD for the caster and nearby party members.
Effect is applied as a reduction to After Attack Delay.
Does not stack with other performance skills.

8205.name: Shield Reflect
description: Description : Automatically reflects a fixed amount of damage to nearby melee attackers for a set duration.

8221.name: Sacrifice
description: Description : Redirects all damage taken by the summoner to the caster.
The summoner’s Lv must be within 10 levels of the mercenary.
The effect is canceled if the distance is exceeded, the map changes, or either character dies.

8237.name: Sense
description: Description : Displays information about the selected monster to the caster and party members.

323.name: Dance Lessons
description: Description : Improves proficiency with whips and increases mental focus.
ATK and CRIT bonuses apply only while a whip is equipped.

324.name: Slinging Arrow
description: Throws an Arrow using a whip to deal Ranged Physical Damage twice.
Damage is increased by INT and follows the equipped Arrow property.

325.name: Hip Shaker
description: Prerequisite : Amp Lv. 1, Dance Lessons Lv. 1
Target : 9 x 9 cells around self (enemies within range).
Description : Inflicts SP damage once to enemies within range.
Success chance increases with skill level.
Usable only in PvP and Siege Mode.

326.name: Dazzler
description: Description : Attempts to inflict Stun on all enemies on screen.
Stun chance increases with skill level.
Party members may be affected at a low chance.
Chance is reduced by Status Ailment resistance.

327.name: Focus Ballet
description: Target : 31 x 31 cells around self (self and party members within range).
Description : Increases HIT of targets within range for the duration.
Does not stack with other Dance skills.

329.name: Lady Luck
description: Target : 31 x 31 cells around self (self and party members within range).
Description : Increases CRIT and Critical Damage of targets within range for the duration.
Does not stack with other Dance skills.

330.name: Gypsy's Kiss
description: Target : 31 x 31 cells around self (self and party members within range).
Description : Increases MSP and reduces SP consumption for skills for all targets within range.
Does not stack with other dance skills.

334.name: Loving Touch
description: Prerequisite : Requires marriage and a wedding ring to be equipped.
Description : Can only be used for your partner.
Sacrifices your own HP to recover your partner's HP.
Cannot be used if your remaining HP is 10% or lower.

335.name: Undying Love
description: Prerequisite : Requires marriage and a wedding ring to be equipped.
Description : Can only be used for your partner.
Consumes your own SP to recover your partner's SP.
Cannot be used if your remaining SP is 10% or lower.

21.name: Thunder Storm
description: Description : Calls down lightning at the designated location, dealing Wind Magical Damage equal to MATK 100% to enemies within a 5 x 5 cell area.
Damage is further increased based on the caster’s INT.

336.name: Romantic Rendeavous
description: Prerequisite : Requires marriage and a wedding ring to be equipped.
Description : Summons your partner to your current location.
Cannot be used in areas where Warp Portal is unavailable or in siege maps.

328.name: Slow Grace
description: Target : 9 x 9 cells around self (enemy players within range).
Description : Reduces Movement Speed and ASPD of enemy players within range for 60 sec.
Removes existing Movement Speed and ASPD buffs.
Does not stack with other Dance skills.
Usable only in PvP and Siege Mode.

322.name: Song of Lutie
description: Target : 31 x 31 cells around self (self and party members within range).
Description : Increases MHP and received Heal effect for the caster and nearby party members.
Does not stack with other performance skills.

321.name: Magic Strings
description: Target : 31 x 31 cells around self (self and party members within range).
Description : Reduces Variable Casting Time and Global Delay for the caster and nearby party members.
Does not stack with other performance skills.

318.name: Unbarring Octave
description: Description : Attempts to inflict Frozen on all enemies within the current screen.
Freeze chance increases with skill level and is reduced by the target’s Status Ailment resistance.
Party members have a low chance to be affected.
In PvP, all players can be affected.

2537.name: Power of Odin
description: Description : Temporarily increases physical and magic attack power while reducing physical and magic defense.

317.name: Unchained Serenade
description: Prerequisite : Amp Lv. 1, Music Lessons Lv. 1
Target : 9 x 9 cells around self (normal enemy monsters within range)
Description : Deals Neutral-Property damage to enemies within range using sound waves.
Damage increases with skill level and job level.
Usable only in PvP and Siege modes.

312.name: Power Cord
description: Target : 31 x 31 cells around self (self and party members within range)
Description : For the duration, reduces gemstone consumption by 1 when party members within range use gemstone-consuming magic.
Cannot overlap with other Ensemble skills.
To activate an Ensemble skill, a Bard and Dancer must be within 9 x 9 cells of each other.
After activation, the caster and partner suffer Ensemble Aftereffect for 10 sec (unable to use skills, reduced movement speed, and reduced ASPD).

311.name: Classical Pluck
description: Target : 9 x 9 cells around self (all players within range, excluding self)
Description : Disables the use of skills and magic for all targets within range, excluding the caster, for 30 sec.
Cannot overlap with other Ensemble skills.
To activate an Ensemble skill, a Bard and Dancer must be within 9 x 9 cells of each other.
After activation, the caster and partner suffer Ensemble Aftereffect for 10 sec (unable to use skills, reduced movement speed, and reduced ASPD).
This skill can only be used in PvP and Siege modes.

310.name: Harmonic Lick
description: Target : 31 x 31 cells around self (self and party members within range)
Description : Randomly grants one of the following beneficial effects to allies within range for 60 sec.
Cannot overlap with other Ensemble skills.
To activate an Ensemble skill, a Bard and Dancer must be within 9 x 9 cells of each other.
After activation, the caster and partner suffer Ensemble Aftereffect for 10 sec (unable to use skills, reduced movement speed, and reduced ASPD).

308.name: Down Tempo
description: Target : 9 x 9 cells around self (enemy players within range)
Description : Sets the DEF of enemy players within range to 0 for 60 sec.
Cannot overlap with other Ensemble skills.
To activate an Ensemble skill, a Bard and Dancer must be within 9 x 9 cells of each other.
After activation, the caster and partner suffer Ensemble Aftereffect for 10 sec (unable to use skills, reduced movement speed, and reduced ASPD).
This skill can only be used in PvP and Siege modes.

307.name: Mental Sensing
description: Target : 31 x 31 cells around self (self and party members within range)
Description : Increases EXP gained from defeating monsters for the caster and party members within range for the duration.
Cannot overlap with other Ensemble skills.
To activate an Ensemble skill, a Bard and Dancer must be within 9 x 9 cells of each other.
After activation, the caster and partner suffer Ensemble Aftereffect for 10 sec (unable to use skills, reduced movement speed, and reduced ASPD).

306.name: Lullaby
description: Target : 9 x 9 cells around self (normal monsters within range)
Description : Has a chance to inflict Sleep on targets within range.
The chance and Duration are reduced by the target’s status ailment resistance.
Can overlap with other Ensemble skills.
To activate an Ensemble skill, a Bard and Dancer must be within 9 x 9 cells of each other.
After activation, the caster and partner suffer Ensemble Aftereffect for 10 sec (unable to use skills, reduced movement speed, and reduced ASPD).
Boss monsters are immune to Sleep.

304.name: Amp
description: Description : Reduces SP consumption for Performance, Ensemble, and Dance skills by 40% for a certain duration.
Can be used together with Encore.

19.name: Fire Bolt
description: Description : Fires a flame-forged Arrow at the target, dealing Fire Magical Damage equal to MATK 100%.
Damage is further increased based on the caster’s INT.

303.name: Coma
description: Effect : Sets the target’s HP and SP to 1.
Note : Can only be activated via Hocus-pocus

302.name: Rejuvenation
description: Effect : Fully restores HP and SP, and cures all Status Ailment.
Note : Can only be activated via Hocus-pocus

298.name: Questioning
description: Effect : Causes the target to display the ‘?’ emote. Nothing else happens.
Note : Can only be activated via Hocus-pocus

290.name: Hocus-pocus
description: Prerequisite : Hindsight Lv. 5, Dispell Lv. 1, Land Protector Lv. 1
The number of possible skills that can be randomly activated increases with skill level.
Even if a gemstone consumption–negating effect is active, at least 1 Yellow Gemstone is always consumed.

22.name: Divine Protection
description: Description : Increases defense against attacks from Demon Monsters and Undead-Property enemies. Damage reduction increases as the character’s level rises.
The damage reduction is subtracted from the final damage taken from Demon Monsters and Undead-Property enemies.

258.name: Spear Quicken
description: Increases ASPD, CRIT, and FLEE Rate.
Duration, CRIT, and FLEE Rate increase by skill level.
The effect ends if the spear is unequipped or a different weapon type is equipped.

257.name: Defending Aura
description: When used, reduces Ranged Physical Damage Taken by a significant amount.
Movement speed and ASPD are reduced while active, but the ASPD penalty decreases by skill level.
Using the skill again cancels the effect. The effect also ends if the shield is unequipped.

355.name: Aura Blade
description: Prerequisite : Bash Lv. 5, Magnum Break Lv. 5, Two Handed Sword Mastery Lv. 5
Description : Infuses your weapon with aura, increasing damage when attacking.
Additional damage is based on your Base Level.

356.name: Parry
description: Prerequisite : Provoke Lv. 5, Two Handed Sword Mastery Lv. 10, Two Hand Quicken Lv. 3
Description : Blocks incoming attacks with your sword.
On a successful block, you take no damage and the attack is negated.

251.name: Shield Boomerang
description: Throws the shield to deal Ranged Physical Damage of Neutral-Property to a distant target.
Damage increases based on the shield’s refinement and weight.

357.name: Spear Dynamo
description: Prerequisite : Increase HP Recovery Lv. 5, Spear Mastery Lv. 5, Peco Peco Ride Lv. 1
Description : Increases HIT and ATK while reducing defense, and grants the Endure effect.
The effect is removed when equipment is changed.

358.name: Relax
description: Prerequisite : Provoke Lv. 5, Increase HP Recovery Lv. 10, Endure Lv. 3
Description : Relaxes the body to greatly increase HP recovery.
The effect is canceled if you stand up, change equipment, or use items.

359.name: Frenzy
description: Description : Enters a berserk state, increasing HP, ATK, and movement speed, but reducing FLEE Rate.
You cannot use items or receive healing skills, and HP gradually decreases over time.
After use, natural HP and SP recovery is disabled for 5 minutes.

8002.name: Urgent Escape
description: Description : Temporarily increases movement speed of the player and homunculus, allowing quick escape in emergencies.

361.name: Assumptio
description: Prerequisite : Angelus Lv. 1, Increase SP Recovery Lv. 3, Impositio Manus Lv. 3
Description : Blesses the target with divine protection, increasing DEF and received Heal Amount for a duration.

362.name: Basilica
description: Prerequisite : Gloria Lv. 2, Increase SP Recovery Lv. 1, Kyrie Eleison Lv. 3
Description : Embraces sacred power, increasing Holy Magical Damage and Physical Damage to Undead Enemies for a duration.

8010.name: Flitting

1.text: ASPD +3 / Damage 110% / Duration 60 sec / Cooldown 60 sec

2.text: ASPD +6 / Damage 115% / Duration 55 sec / Cooldown 75 sec

3.text: ASPD +9 / Damage 120% / Duration 50 sec / Cooldown 90 sec

4.text: ASPD +12 / Damage 125% / Duration 45 sec / Cooldown 105 sec

5.text: ASPD +15 / Damage 130% / Duration 40 sec / Cooldown 120 sec

description: Description : Temporarily greatly increases the ASPD and attack power of the FILIR homunculus.
[Lv 1] ASPD +3 / Damage 110% / Duration 60 sec / Cooldown 60 sec
[Lv 2] ASPD +6 / Damage 115% / Duration 55 sec / Cooldown 75 sec
[Lv 3] ASPD +9 / Damage 120% / Duration 50 sec / Cooldown 90 sec
[Lv 4] ASPD +12 / Damage 125% / Duration 45 sec / Cooldown 105 sec
[Lv 5] ASPD +15 / Damage 130% / Duration 40 sec / Cooldown 120 sec

363.name: Meditation
description: Prerequisite : Increase SP Recovery Lv. 5, Lex Divina Lv. 5, Aspersio Lv. 3
Description : Increases Max SP and SP Recovery Rate.
Slightly increases the healing effect of Heal.

364.name: Soul Drain
description: Prerequisite : Increase SP Recovery Lv. 5, Soul Strike Lv. 7
When a monster is defeated by magic, recovers SP based on the monster’s level.
The effect is determined by the skill used immediately before activation.

8016.name: Self-Destruction
description: Description : Deals damage proportional to the homunculus’s MHP to enemies within a 9 x 9 area around it, then self-destructs.
Ignores defense, and intimacy is set to 1 after use.

365.name: Stave Crasher
description: Description : Strikes a single enemy with Neutral-Property physical damage based on MATK.
Damage is reduced by the target’s DEF.

366.name: Mystical Amplification
description: Description : Greatly amplifies MATK for 300 sec.

367.name: Gloria Domini
description: Prerequisite : Endure Lv. 5, Demon Bane Lv. 2
Description : Calls down a massive cross to deal Holy Magical Damage.
Reduces the target’s Holy-Property resistance by 20% for 5 sec.
Damage increases based on the caster’s Base Level.

23.name: Demon Bane
description: Description : Enhances attacks against Demon Monsters and Undead-Property enemies. Attack power increases as the character’s level rises.
Additional damage is added to attacks against Demon Monsters and Physical Damage to Undead Enemies.

368.name: Martyr's Reckoning
description: Prerequisite : Endure Lv. 1, Gloria Domini Lv. 3
Description : Sacrifices 9% of the caster’s HP per hit to deal equal damage to the target.
After use, the next 5 normal melee attacks become special attacks.
This damage may incapacitate the caster.

369.name: Battle Chant
description: Prerequisite : Faith Lv. 8, Demon Bane Lv. 5
Description : Sings a holy hymn that randomly applies 1 of 10 negative effects to enemies and 1 of 10 positive effects to allies within range.
Affects all players and enemies within range.
If inflicted with Silence while casting, Battle Chant is canceled.

370.name: Raging Palm Strike
description: Prerequisite : Iron Fists Lv. 7, Summon Spirit Sphere Lv. 5
Description : Delivers a powerful palm strike that deals damage after a 1 sec delay and knocks the target back.
Can only be used while in Fury state.

10007.name: Glorious Wounds
description: Description : Within a 5 x 5 cell area centered on the guild Pub Playmate, all Guildsman gain up to +5 VIT.

371.name: Glacier Fist
description: Prerequisite : Iron Fists Lv. 5, Raging Trifecta Blow Lv. 5, Raging Thrust Lv. 3
Description : A chained follow-up attack usable after Raging Trifecta Blow, Raging Quadruple Blow, or Raging Thrust.
Can only be activated after Raging Thrust.
Damage increases based on the caster’s Base Level.

8206.name: Frenzy
description: Description : Enters a berserk state, increasing HP, movement speed, and attack power, but reducing FLEE Rate and disabling all other actions.
Items and Heal cannot be used, and HP gradually drains over time.
After the effect ends, HP and SP do not naturally recover for 5 minutes.

372.name: Chain Crush Combo
description: Prerequisite : Iron Fists Lv. 5, Summon Spirit Sphere Lv. 5, Glacier Fist Lv. 2
Description : A chained combo attack that follows Raging Trifecta Blow, Raging Quadruple Blow, Raging Thrust, or Glacier Fist.
Consumes 1 Spirit Sphere to deal additional damage.
After using Chain Crush Combo, Guillotine Fist can be activated.
After Raging Thrust, the caster may choose to use either Chain Crush Combo or Glacier Fist, but Glacier Fist cannot be used directly after Chain Crush Combo.
Damage increases based on the caster’s STR and Base Level.

8216.name: Pierce
description: Description : Attacks an enemy with a spear.
Number of hits varies by target size and requires a spear.

8007.name: Adamantium Skin
description: Description : Permanently increases the homunculus’s defense, and boosts maximum MHP and HP Recovery Rate.

8015.name: Instruction Change
description: Description : Increases the homunculus’s INT and STR.

376.name: Advanced Katar Mastery
description: Prerequisite : Double Attack Lv. 5, Katar Mastery Lv. 7
Description : Increases the damage of Katar weapons used by Assassin.

10013.name: Emergency Call
description: Description : Usable only in Siege Mode. Can only be used by the guild Pub Playmate. Gathers all Guildsman to the side of the guild Pub Playmate.

378.name: Enchant Deadly Poison
description: Description : Coats the weapon with a more potent poison than Enchant Poison.
Enemies struck by the enchanted weapon have a chance to be afflicted with a powerful poison that rapidly drains HP.

379.name: Soul Destroyer
description: Prerequisite : Double Attack Lv. 5, Envenom Lv. 5, Cloaking Lv. 3, Enchant Poison Lv. 6
Description : Deals powerful Ranged Physical Damage to a single target.
Has a chance equal to half of the caster’s CRIT to inflict a critical hit.
Damage is increased based on the caster’s Base Level, STR, and INT.
Only half of the total Critical Damage bonus is applied.

3033.name: Slapping Herb
description: A herb leaf with an intense scent that feels like a slap to the head when inhaled.
Cures Stun, Fear, Confusion, and Hallucination when used.

380.name: Falcon Eyes
description: Prerequisite : Owl's Eye Lv. 10, Vulture's Eye Lv. 10, Improve Concentration Lv. 10, Falconry Mastery Lv. 1
Description : Increases all basic stats by 5, and further enhances HIT, damage, and CRIT for the duration.

3041.name: The World of the Dead
description: Description : Returns to Niflheim, the World of the Dead.
Cannot be reused for 5 minutes after use.

381.name: Falcon Assault
description: Prerequisite : Vulture's Eye Lv. 5, Falconry Mastery Lv. 1, Blitz Beat Lv. 5, Steel Crow Lv. 3
Description : Commands the falcon to launch a concentrated assault on a single enemy.
Damage increases based on skill level and the caster’s Base Level.

8001.name: Healing Hands
description: Description : Recovers a target player’s HP.
Has the same effectiveness as the Acolyte Heal skill.
Consumes 1 Red Slim Potion when used.
Healing is increased by Skill Lv, and further scales with the caster’s Lv and INT.

382.name: Focused Arrow Strike
description: Prerequisite : Double Strafe Lv. 5, Improve Concentration Lv. 10
Description : Fires a powerful shot at a single target, dealing Ranged Physical Damage to the target and enemies within a 5 x 5 cell area around it.
Has an additional chance equal to 50% of the caster’s CRIT to apply Critical Damage.
Only half of the total Critical Damage bonus is applied.
The attack range of Focused Arrow Strike is fixed at 11 cells.

44.name: Vulture's Eye
description: Description : When using a bow, increases attack range and improves HIT.
